Various Engineering Roles and What we Look for

 Mechanical Design Engineer: The Mechanical Design Engineer is responsible for researching, planning, designing and developing the mechanical and structural portions of the company’s products. This individual will also direct and coordinate activities involved in process selection for the fabrication, assembly and testing of mechanical designs in accordance with product requirements. This individual might serve as the lead engineer on projects and may coordinate the work of others or mentor other employees.

Electrical Engineer: The Electrical Engineer will support the team by acting as lead on projects and by providing technical leadership within the electrical engineering group and also responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining the electrical systems and component. Their work ensures that devices are safe, reliable, and compliant with regulatory standards.

Systems Engineer: The Systems Engineers analyzes, designs, develops and tests medical device systems to ensure the integration of hardware, software, reliability, regulatory compliance, and safety requirements. Systems Engineers serve as contributing members of the Systems Engineering group responsible for the design and development of not only the overall radiation delivery system of the product, but also the subsystems which comprise it. 

Manufacturing Engineer: The Manufacturing Engineer engages closely with peers to ensure the appropriateness of engineering specifications and the development of robust manufacturing processes to support new product introductions, quality improvements and cost reduction. They will serve as a technical point person in manufacturing for definition, development, troubleshooting and optimization of manufacturing processes, equipment, and tools.

Test Engineer: The Product Test Engineer works on the verification and validation, software and system quality assurance of medical devices. The Test Engineer will also develop test cases and procedures; execute test protocols; write and improve Standard Operating Procedures and Work Instructions; perform V&V work using state of the art testing and test automation tools.

Motion Control Engineer: The Motion Control Engineer is responsible for the research, planning, design, and development of the core software elements that control the critical motion mechanisms contributing to the function and performance Accuray’s radiation therapy products. This specialized role will also assist with defining the high-level architecture and detailed hardware implementation of these motion devices, leveraging a cross-functional skillset across multiple applicable engineering disciplines (Software, Mechanical, Electrical, Systems, etc) to help solve complex engineering problems.

Imaging Systems Engineer: The Imaging Systems Engineer at Accuray defines, develops, and supports systems for image-guided radiation therapy. This product-focused role emphasizes the development and integration of imaging hardware, software, and algorithms to enable clinical use cases, assure patient outcomes, achieve customer satisfaction, and improve product reliability. The successful candidate will work proactively and collaboratively on development teams to provide subject matter expertise and facilitate project execution, through intimate understanding of imaging subsystems and components, their interfaces, and clinical imaging tasks.

What you'll Do

Evaluating threat models across the AI lifecycle to address risks including prompt injection, data poisoning, adversarial attacks, model compromise, etc.

Developing Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) and metrics to monitor AI security posture and report trends to senior leadership and risk committees.

Supporting internal audits and regulatory examinations related to AI governance and cybersecurity risk.

Staying current on emerging AI technologies, agentic architectures, evolving threat landscapes, and industry guidelines.

3+ years of hands-on experience in AI governance / Responsible AI, including defining controls, risk assessments, compliance oversight, or assurance of AI/ML systems.

6+ years of experience in risk management, cybersecurity, compliance, or consulting with experience in client-facing or multi-functional delivery.

Demonstrated experience translating AI governance requirements into technical security controls and working with engineering teams to implement and scale them.

Experience performing AI threat modeling across traditional ML and Generative AI systems, including agent-based architectures.

Familiarity with agentic AI technologies and protocols, including AI agents and autonomous workflows, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication etc.

Familiarity with AI governance standards and regulatory frameworks such as NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, EU AI Act, and others.

Experience with governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) platforms and collaboration with privacy, legal, and security teams.

Knowledge of access control frameworks for AI systems, particularly regarding tool invocation and agent permissions.

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field required; advanced degree or equivalent experience preferred.

Relevant certifications like AIGP, CISSP, CISA, CISM, Security+, ISO 42001 Implementer/Auditor, or an equivalent credential.

The Sr. AI Applied Scientist (Fraud Prevention): drives experimental research and novel algorithm development to detect and predict emerging fraud trends. The candidate has an innovative approach with passion for fraud detection and prevention along with creativity in data visualization. The scientist will work with different partners across Adobe to develop outstanding fraud detection capabilities. 

What you'll Do 

Develop LLM Agentic Workflow and ML models to predict and detect fraud from historical and emerging trends across various platforms and products.

Automate manual workflows with AI to build efficiencies and scale up fraud reviews, investigations, and operational workflows. 

Translate investigations and intel into root cause analysis to find opportunities for scale. 

Lead experimental research to invent novel ML algorithms and LLM-based agentic workflows for fraud detection, pushing the state-of-the-art in the field.

Design and validate new automation paradigms using state-of-the-art AI, driving the transfer of these research innovations into scalable operational processes.

What you need to succeed

Proficiency in programming languages such as SQL, Python or R. 
Strong understanding of big data technologies and distributed computing frameworks (e.g., Hadoop, Spark) for handling large-scale datasets. 

Deep research experience in Large Language Models (LLMs) and Agentic Workflows, with a proven track record of translating theoretical research into production-grade systems.

Excellent communication and leadership skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and drive alignment on fraud detection strategies. 

Proven track record of leading complex AI/ML projects from conception to production deployment, delivering tangible business value. 

Experience with fraud detection tools and platforms (e.g., fraud detection APIs, fraud management systems) is highly recommended.

The success of generative AI guardrails is not determined solely by model architecture; it is defined by the quality of the concepts we protect, the robustness of our detection science, and the realism of our evaluation methodology. 

The Adobe Firefly Applied Science & Machine Learning team is expanding its IP guardrail systems for building safe and compliant image, video, and audio generative models. A central challenge is long-tail IP coverage: foundation models cannot internalize every protected concept. Advancing our guardrails therefore requires principled approaches to multimodal knowledge integration, detection modeling, and real-world evaluation science. 

We are seeking an Applied Scientist to drive the scientific development of IP concept modeling, detection strategies, and evaluation frameworks that determine the robustness ceiling of our guardrail systems. This is a research-oriented role focused on advancing multimodal detection and evaluation methodologies at production scale. 

 

Research Areas You Will Drive 

Multimodal Concept Modeling & Knowledge Integration 

Develop principled methods for representing and organizing large-scale IP concept spaces across text, image, and audio. 

Study how retrieval-augmented systems (RAG), embedding alignment, and structured knowledge can complement multimodal foundation models. 

Investigate strategies for improving long-tail concept coverage beyond what VLMs inherently encode. 

Design concept modeling techniques that meaningfully influence downstream guardrail decisions. 

Data Acquisition & Curation for Detection 

Develop scalable approaches for acquiring and curating high-quality multimodal datasets that improve detection coverage for IP-sensitive concepts. 

Drive long-tail expansion through targeted data collection, web-scale sourcing, and synthetic data generation. 

Analyze failure cases in generative outputs to inform targeted data acquisition and dataset refinement. 

Design efficient data curation and labeling strategies that improve signal quality and robustness of downstream detection systems. 

 

Evaluation Methodology & Benchmark Design 

Define evaluation frameworks that reflect real-world Firefly usage patterns. 

Design multimodal benchmark datasets that stress-test guardrails under realistic and adversarial scenarios. 

Develop metrics that capture over-blocking, under-blocking, semantic similarity, and near-miss generation. 

Establish statistically rigorous offline and online evaluation strategies that guide research prioritization. 

Study how evaluation quality constrains and enables system-level progress. 

Feedback-Driven Scientific Iteration 

Leverage large-scale product feedback signals to identify systematic weaknesses in guardrail behavior. 

Translate real-world interaction patterns into structured evaluation hypotheses. 

Build reproducible experimental pipelines that enable continuous scientific iteration. 

 

What You’ll Do 

Lead scientific design of IP concept expansion and detection methodologies. 

Formulate hypotheses around long-tail coverage, detection robustness, and evaluation gaps. 

Run rigorous experiments to quantify performance ceilings and identify high-leverage improvements. 

Partner closely with generative model scientists to ensure alignment between detection, guidance, and evaluation systems. 

Contribute to intellectual property and potential publications in multimodal learning, evaluation science, or AI safety. 

 

What You’ll Need to Succeed 

Research & Technical Depth 

PhD or MS in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI, or related field. 

5+ years of experience in applied ML, multimodal systems, or evaluation research. 

Strong understanding of Vision-Language Models, multimodal transformers, and embedding-based retrieval systems. 

Experience designing and analyzing large-scale benchmarks and evaluation datasets. 

Solid background in statistical analysis, experimental design, and performance trade-off evaluation. 

Proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch). 

Scientific Approach 

Ability to reason about long-tail distributions and concept coverage gaps. 

Experience analyzing complex multimodal system failure modes. 

Strong intuition for measurement of quality and evaluation bias. 

Comfort operating in ambiguous, research-driven problem spaces. 

AI-Accelerated Research Execution 

Demonstrated ability to use AI coding tools and AI-assisted workflows to rapidly prototype evaluation frameworks, detection experiments, and data analysis. 

Ability to scale scientific insight through high-velocity experimentation. 

 

Preferred Qualifications 

Experience in safety evaluation, trust & safety systems, or content moderation science. 

Background in retrieval-augmented systems, knowledge graph modeling, or large-scale embedding systems. 

Publications in venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, ACL, or equivalent industry research impact. 

Experience translating evaluation science into deployed guardrail improvements.

Generative AI is redefining creativity. Ensuring that these systems are safe, controllable, and respectful of intellectual property is one of the most important open research challenges in the field. 

The Adobe Firefly Applied Science & Machine Learning team is building next-generation multimodal guardrail systems for building safe and compliant image, video, and audio generative models powering Firefly.com. Our goal extends beyond reactive blocking; we are developing model-level guidance mechanisms that proactively steer generation away from IP-violating concepts while preserving creative intent and usability. 

We are seeking a Applied Scientist with strong multimodal depth and research instincts to help define and develop the frontier of IP-aware generative modeling. This role sits at the intersection of generative model alignment, multimodal reasoning, and large-scale inference systems. 

 

Research Areas You Will Drive 

Inference-Time Alignment & Optimization 

Research and implement inference-time control techniques (guided decoding, constrained sampling, classifier guidance, reward-based steering). 

Optimize large multimodal systems for low-latency, production-scale deployment without sacrificing alignment quality. 

Identify and mitigate failure modes in generative pipelines at scale. 

Rapid Scientific Experimentation 

Develop and complete rigorous experiments to evaluate trade-offs between creativity, fidelity, and IP safety. 

Develop new evaluation methodologies and benchmarks for multimodal IP compliance. 

Contribute novel technical insights that may lead to publications or internal intellectual property. 

Vision-Language & Multimodal Reasoning 

Advance the use of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and multimodal foundation models for semantic IP understanding. 

Explore joint reasoning between perception and generation systems to enable real-time steering. 

Experiment how various techniques, e.g. multimodal embeddings, cross-attention mechanisms, etc., can be used for safety-aware inference. 

Multimodal IP-Aware Generative Modeling 

Develop novel approaches for integrating IP constraints directly into generative model behavior. 

Investigate controllable generation techniques that shift models from post-hoc blocking toward guided, alignment-aware synthesis. 

Develop training and fine-tuning strategies that embed guardrail signals into model representations. 

 

What You’ll Do 

Architect and evolve the Firefly IP Guard pipeline across first-party and third-party generative models. 

Collaborate with research scientists, ML engineers and other key partners like applied ethics, legal etc., to translate scientific advances into deployed systems. 

Communicate with other non-technical collaborators to help drive awareness about the implemented technologies. 

Drive end-to-end experimentation, from hypothesis formulation through model implementation and large-scale evaluation. 

Contribute to the broader research strategy around generative AI alignment and safety within Adobe. 

 

What You’ll Need to Succeed 

Research & Technical Depth 

PhD or MS in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI, or related field. 

5+ years of experience in applied ML or generative AI research (industry or academia). 

Strong background in large-scale generative models (diffusion models, multimodal transformers, autoregressive systems). 

Deep experience with model fine-tuning, alignment strategies, and representation learning. 

Expertise in Vision-Language Models or multimodal foundation models. 

Proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch), with experience of training and deploying large models. 

Scientific & Systems Rigor 

Strong experimental development and statistical evaluation skills. 

Experience analyzing complex failure modes in multimodal systems. 

Understanding of large-scale inference systems and production ML constraints. 

Ability to navigate open-ended research spaces and identify high-leverage problems. 

AI-Accelerated Development 

Demonstrated ability to use AI coding tools and AI-assisted development workflows to rapidly prototype, experiment, and scale research impact. 

Comfort operating in an AI-augmented development environment, using generative tools to increase iteration speed, code quality, and research throughput. 

Ability to combine scientific rigor with high-velocity execution. 

Collaborative Approach 

Experience working in cross-functional research-to-product environments. 

Ability to clearly communicate complex scientific ideas to diverse collaborators. 

 

Preferred Qualifications 

Research contributions in controllable generation, alignment, AI safety, or multimodal learning. 

Publications in leading conferences (CVPR, ICCV, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, SIGGRAPH) or equivalent industry impact. 

Experience deploying generative models to large user bases. 

Background in safety evaluation frameworks, explainability or adversarial robustness.

Guardrails Platform Architecture

Identify and address system-level bottlenecks to ensure scalable and reliable deployment. 

 

Safety-Aware Data Systems 

Develop strategies to identify and mitigate intellectual property and trust & safety risks in large-scale datasets. 

Advance methods to improve coverage and robustness of safety systems, particularly across long-tail and evolving concept spaces. 

Drive system-level thinking around efficiency, scalability, and reliability of data-centric safety mechanisms. 

Partner with modeling teams to ensure data quality and safety signals effectively translate into improved model behavior. 

 

What You’ll Do 

Lead the architectural development of scalable, data-centric safety and guardrail systems across multimodal ML platforms. 

Drive applied ML initiatives spanning data-centric safety, detection, and feedback-driven system improvement. 

Translate research advances into production-ready systems, balancing model quality, scalability, and efficiency. 

Act as a technical lead and mentor, guiding applied scientists and engineers while setting high standards for system design and execution. 

Shape the long-term technical strategy for building robust, scalable, and responsible generative AI systems at Adobe. 

 

What You’ll Need to Succeed 

Research & Technical Depth 

PhD or MS in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI, or a related field. 

8+ years of experience building and deploying machine learning systems in production environments, with demonstrated end-to-end ownership. 

Strong expertise in multimodal machine learning, including vision-language and generative models. 

Experience working with large-scale datasets and applying data-centric approaches to improve system performance and robustness. 

Proficiency in modern ML development ecosystems (e.g., Python, PyTorch), with the ability to translate research into scalable implementations. 

ML Systems Architecture

Job Details

We are seeking a highly skilled Information Retrieval Engineer to lead the development and optimization of retrieval systems that power context-aware large language models (LLMs). This role focuses on building robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines to ensure AI agents and applications have access to the most relevant, timely, and high-quality information.

You'll work at the intersection of data engineering, machine learning, and knowledge management—enabling better reasoning, accuracy, and performance for enterprise-grade AI systems.

Key Responsibilities

RAG System Design:

Architect and deploy scalable retrieval pipelines using vector databases (e.g., FAISS, Weaviate, Pinecone, Qdrant)

Implement semantic search infrastructure and hybrid retrieval systems (semantic + keyword)

Data Processing & Ingestion:

Build ingestion pipelines for both structured and unstructured data sources

Implement document chunking strategies, embedding generation (e.g., OpenAI, Cohere, HuggingFace), and metadata tagging

Retrieval Optimization:

Fine-tune relevance scoring, reranking algorithms, and query understanding mechanisms

Develop techniques to improve precision/recall for specific business domains or user tasks

Knowledge Enhancement:

Create and maintain knowledge graphs to support context linking and disambiguation

Manage data freshness and version control to ensure consistency and reliability of retrieved content

Reasoning Support:

Design and iterate on context window strategies that improve LLM reasoning (e.g., adaptive injection, task-based retrieval)

Collaborate with prompt engineers and model developers to align retrieval outputs with downstream model behavior

Performance Monitoring:

Track key retrieval metrics such as accuracy, latency, and fallback rate

Implement caching, prefetching, and deduplication strategies to optimize system responsiveness

Qualifications

Required:

4+ years in data engineering, ML infrastructure, or information retrieval

Experience building and deploying RAG pipelines or semantic search systems

Strong Python skills and familiarity with retrieval libraries (e.g., Haystack, LangChain, Elasticsearch, Milvus)

Proficiency with embedding models, vector similarity search, and document indexing

Familiarity with cloud platforms and MLOps tooling (e.g., Airflow, dbt, Docker)

Preferred:

Knowledge of graph databases (e.g., Neo4j, TigerGraph) or knowledge graph design

Experience optimizing retrieval for LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral)

Background in IR/NLP, Search Engineering, or Cognitive Computing

Bachelors or Masters Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field

Success in This Role Looks Like:

High-recall, low-latency retrieval pipelines that enhance LLM outputs with accurate, relevant context

Modular, reusable RAG components that can be applied across use cases and domains

Continuous improvement of retrieval relevance and reasoning alignment through experimentation and monitoring

Strong collaboration with AI engineers, prompt engineers, and data owners to maintain data quality and user trust

The Opportunity 

Adobe’s products empower people everywhere to imagine, create, and transform how the world works. Our Solutions Consultants are the trusted guides who bring that power to life for customers—turning possibility into clarity, and vision into measurable impact.

We are seeking a Director, Global Solutions Consulting to lead well-established teams across North America and EMEA. This leader will set the vision, standards, and operating model for our world-class team. The role spans both Creative Cloud and Document Cloud solution areas while remaining product-agnostic enough to flex with evolving portfolio needs. The Director will define excellence in discovery, value storytelling, demo execution, Proof of Value (PoV) methodology, and cross-functional execution.
 

What You’ll Lead

You will lead well-established Solutions Consulting teams across North America and EMEA. You will craft a unified standard of excellence for both Creative Cloud and Document Cloud solutions. With you on the team, we will ensure consistent execution, seamless cross-regional collaboration, and strong alignment with Sales, Product, Customer Success, and Marketing partners!
 

What You’ll Do

Set strategic direction and operating standards for the Global Solutions Consulting organization.

Drive revenue impact by elevating discovery, solution mapping, proof of value rigor, and storytelling

Partner closely with regional Sales leaders and Sales Operations to influence pipeline, forecast accuracy, and deal strategy.

Build and mentor a strong management bench, creating a high-performance culture rooted in accountability, curiosity, and growth.

Lead cross-functional collaboration with Product, PMM, Customer Success, and Professional Services.

Work with leadership team to establish global standard methodologies, demo frameworks, reusable assets, and enablement programs.

Represent Solutions Consulting as an executive sponsor with key customers.
 

What You’ll Bring

10+ years of Solutions Consulting, Pre-Sales, or related experience, with 3–5+ years leading multi-region teams.

Deep proficiency in consultative discovery, value storytelling, enterprise architecture, and executive communication.

Experience with both Creative Cloud and Document Cloud workflows, or comparable enterprise solutions.

Creative approach to solving tough problems, operational rigor, and experience partnering across Sales, Product, and Customer Success.

Ability to foster an inclusive, high-trust, high-accountability team culture.
 

How You’ll Measure Success

Conversion rate improvement, Average Deal Size growth, and sales cycle efficiency.

Demo and PoV quality benchmarks and adoption of standards across regions.

Team engagement, leadership strength, and talent development.

Operational benchmarks including coverage ratios and capacity utilization.
 

How You’ll Partner
 

You will work seamlessly with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, Product Marketing, Customer Success, Professional Services, RevOps, and Alliances to ensure alignment, consistent go-to-market execution, and a frictionless customer experience across all regions.
 

Team & Culture
 

We thrive when our team is invested in winning together. We're proud of the culture we're building and want to bring in a leader that makes us all better. You will nurture a culture of customer-centricity, innovation, curiosity, craftsmanship, and cross-team collaboration. As leaders, we model the behaviors we expect—clarity, empathy, execution excellence, and continuous improvement.
 

Location & Travel
 

This role leads distributed teams across North America and EMEA. Travel is required for leadership meetings, customer engagements, team events, and cross-functional alignment.

Proven experience providing enterprise architecture leadership across transformation programmes, from early visioning and pre-sales through delivery, adoption, and platform evolution.

Broad understanding of digital marketing, data, and activation ecosystems.

The ability to craft compelling narratives that translate architectural choices into business-relevant results

Experience operating as a trusted architectural advisor

Strong understanding of AI, automation, and emerging agentic models, and their implications for enterprise platforms.

The Adobe Digital Imaging Data Science Team is looking for a Data Scientist passionate about data and delivering an outstanding product experience. We use extensive product usage data and work closely with product managers, marketing managers, and software engineers to derive insights and build a foundation for reliable data-driven decision-making. You will focus on initiatives like product analytics, dashboards, data engineering, GTM analytics, growth and more. Your main role is to develop and maintain a strong data architecture that enhances reporting, analytics, and experimentation. Over time, you will apply predictive modeling and machine learning to help the organization improve customer experiences. Join us and drive meaningful change in Adobe’s most exciting areas!

Responsibilities:

Partner with product and engineering teams to understand existing product instrumentation and help bridge gaps in data streams to assist data science initiatives.

Analyze product usage patterns to better understand customer behavior including acquisition, engagement, conversion, and retention.

Proactively identify user trends and communicate relevant insights to assist product decision-making.

Automate and optimize data pipelines using SQL and/or Python-based ETL Frameworks.

Build and maintain various dashboards to inform the team about the state of the business, as well as to alert business partners when issues occur.

Architect and implement models to recommend personalized in-app content.

Drive A/B and multivariate tests and build feature-level experiments to validate hypotheses and influence product development decisions.

Requirements:

MS or Ph.D. in data science, computer science, statistics, applied mathematics, engineering, or economics, or equivalent experience.

3 - 5+ years of relevant data science experience.

Experience translating business questions into data analytics approaches.

Strong proficiency in querying and manipulating large datasets using SQL-like languages (Hive, Spark, etc.).

Experience developing and operationalizing consistent approaches to experimentation, using appropriate statistical techniques to reduce bias and interpret statistical significance.

Proficiency with descriptive and inferential statistics (i.e., t-test, chi-square, ANOVA, correlation, regression, etc.) to understand customer engagement and generate hypotheses.

Experience crafting data visualizations and storytelling to efficiently communicate analysis results to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Knowledge of relevant tools in this field such as Hadoop, Hive, Splunk, Spark, Tableau, Excel (Charting and Pivot-Tables), and Power BI.

Experience in product instrumentation is a plus.

Possess natural curiosity and technical competence, being capable of asking critical questions and always ready to address any challenges.

Experience addressing an executive level audience.

Excellent communication, relationship skills, and a strong teammate.

About the Role

The Acrobat Product Marketing team is seeking a strategic Director of Product Marketing, Engagement to lead our Value Discovery team with a focus on delivering meaningful impact. This leader will shape how customers discover, adopt, and build lasting habits around our most important capabilities.

They will define the strategy that connects product innovation to sustained customer value, ensuring new and existing capabilities are clearly positioned, prioritized effectively, and reinforced across the full customer lifecycle. This role owns the narrative and sequencing of key experiences so what we build is not only understood, but consistently used.

Working cross-functionally with teams such as Product, Growth, Lifecycle, GTM, and others, this leader will drive adoption, increase repeat engagement, and translate product improvements into measurable, long-term impact for the business.

What You’ll Do

Define and lead the Value Discovery strategy, shaping how customers discover, adopt, and build lasting habits around our most important capabilities.

Design and operationalize a cross-channel engagement framework that ensures new and existing capabilities are introduced, reinforced, and re-surfaced at the right moments across the customer lifecycle.

Develop engagement messaging framework for key capabilities grounded in user value and existing workflows

Build an always-on content strategy that employs trends, cultural moments, and seasonal events to promote new and existing value

Partner cross-functionally with GTM, Product, Design, Growth, Lifecycle to align engagement strategy with roadmap priorities and business goals.

Embed audience expertise, behavioral insights and adoption data into strategic decision-making to influence product direction.

Drive measurable improvements in feature adoption, depth of usage, and multi-tool engagement.

What We’re Looking For

A strategic product marketing leader who drives behavior change—not just awareness.

A builder of scalable engagement systems, not one-off campaigns.

A strong cross-functional operator who can influence Product, Growth, Lifecycle, Design, and GTM partners and align teams around shared adoption goals.

A problem solver with a customer-first approach who translates workflows and user insights into clear, compelling value narratives.

A data-driven operator who uses adoption metrics, usage patterns, and experimentation to continuously refine strategy.

A leader who can balance long-term critical thinking alongside hands-on execution and operational excellence.

A compelling storyteller who can articulate value in a way that drives clarity, urgency, and action internally and externally.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

10+ years in Product Marketing, Engagement, Lifecycle, or a related field in a subscription-based business, with clear ownership of adoption and engagement metrics.

Proven track record of increasing feature adoption, usage depth, retention, or multi-product engagement.

Experience building cross-channel engagement strategies (in-product, email, paid, owned).

Comfort working closely with Product & Design teams, shaping roadmaps through customer insight, influencing prioritization, and embedding go-to-market thinking into product development.

Strong analytical skills and comfort using data to inform decisions and prioritize investments.

Experience building and leading high-performing teams and influencing senior partners.

Excellent communication skills with the ability to drive clarity and alignment across functions.

A passion for modernizing a legacy product with a clear vision for how AI can drive everyday utility, prove ongoing value, and unlock Acrobat’s next phase of growth.

Director of Global Strategic Sourcing – Technology

The Opportunity 

We are looking for a dynamic Director of Technology Strategic Sourcing to lead high‑impact technology categories. You’ll have the opportunity to set the vision and strategy for the spend categories, shape company‑wide sourcing decisions related to Technology spend and grow as a senior leader within a global sourcing organization. You will deliver significant savings, streamline operations, and raise internal customer satisfaction. You’ll also help standardize how we buy and govern technology through our unified source-to-pay process, enabling faster buying, and strengthening governance companywide.

Collaborating with the Head of Global Strategic Sourcing, you will lead teams of category managers covering over $2.5B in annual spend. The category scope includes Cloud (Compute, Storage, GPU), AI and Data Platforms, Enterprise Software (SaaS and on- premise), Infrastructure (Hardware, Data Center, Network) and Services. Are you a builder and leader who is comfortable in setting strategy, driving execution, developing talent, and influencing senior levels in a fast‑paced, global environment? If you are looking to operate at scale, influence executive decision‑making, and build the next chapter of your leadership career, this role offers both growth and impact.

What you'll Do 

Partner closely with internal customers to understand priorities, unlock value, and deliver measurable outcomes.

Build and continuously evolve multi‑year category strategies aligned to business roadmaps, budgets, and risk posture.

Help standardize technology buying through unified source‑to‑pay processes and contracting standards.

Lead sourcing and cross-functional teams across multiple categories and initiatives from strategy development through sourcing, contracting, and implementation.

Develop organizational capability by mentoring, coaching, and building high‑performing sourcing leaders and teams.

Drive process improvements that increase customer happiness, reduce cycle time, and deliver efficiency gains while ensuring compliance with policies and mitigating supplier risk.

Deploy leading-edge procurement solutions (e.g., AI, RPA, Chatbots, Process Mining) to drive automation, unlocking savings, mitigate risk and transform strategic sourcing processes 

What you need to succeed 

10+ years of demonstrated leadership experience and expertise in strategic sourcing for Technology categories (enterprise software, SaaS/cloud, data/AI, or infra/services) at a global scale and within a fast paced, dynamic organization.

Experience in structuring and negotiating large-scale cloud agreements with hyperscalers. Solid understanding of cloud category market dynamics (offerings, pricing, competitive position, market trends); Demonstrated ability to develop and implement sourcing strategies that translate to significant business outcomes. 

Proven track record in building trusted relationships with diverse partners across all levels (including senior-most levels of an organization) and influence decision‑making that aligns the interests of diverse teams.

Strong people-leadership capabilities, with a track record of attracting, developing, training and retaining outstanding talent.

Experience embedding risk, compliance, and governance into sourcing and contracting processes.

Experience leading high-profile, complex negotiations with multi-faceted relationships (buy from, sell to, joint go-to-market, etc).

We are seeking a Director of Product Marketing, Growth & Platforms to drive user and revenue expansion for Adobe's Creator portfolio. In this role, you will coordinate the growth strategy for Firefly, Photoshop, Lightroom, and Premiere across both web and mobile platforms.

You will be responsible for shaping the expansion approach for this ecosystem and lead a cross functional team passionate about driving impact across two key areas:

Cross-Application Growth: Scale our products within Adobe’s creative ecosystem by integrating workflows and optimizing acquisition funnels across internal and external touchpoints.

Portfolio Lifecycle Management (LCM): Develop our LCM system and omnichannel methods (email, push, in-app messaging, SMS or comparable experience) aimed at improving user engagement and retention.

What You Will Do

Drive Cross-Application Growth Strategies

Workflow Integration: Build cross-application workflows and incorporate Firefly's Generative AI tools into Photoshop, Lightroom, and Premiere.

Journey Optimization: Manage end-to-end user journeys.

Scale branded entry points across the product ecosystem. Support the development of a cross-app platform. Build viral loops and develop our trends and sharing roadmap to drive organic growth.

External Partnerships: Build strategic partnerships to define new entry points and workflows (e.g., LLM providers, hardware, and software partners).

Architect Portfolio Lifecycle Oversight (LCM)

Omnichannel Activation: Manage LCM channels across the Creator portfolio, including push, in-app, email, SMS, App Store Optimization (ASO), and Google Play.

Evergreen Engagement: Direct the evergreen LCM strategy with Outbound Product Marketing to sustain user engagement between major product releases.

Infrastructure Acceleration: Partner with Product and Engineering to advance infrastructure.

Platform modernization: Explore new ways to bring to bear Gen AI technologies to engage users and drive operational excellence.

Orchestrate Cross-Functional Execution & Growth Operations

Growth Operations: Lead high-velocity multivariate testing frameworks to optimize acquisition funnels, monetization models, and user flows.

Product-Led Growth (PLG): Operationalize PLG loops - such as sharing, referrals, and asset remixing to improve user acquisition.

Executive Alignment: Align Engineering, Build, Product, and Marketing around unified growth objectives. Translate growth analytics into clear executive reporting.

What You Need to Succeed

Growth Leadership: 12+ years of leadership experience in growth marketing, product marketing, or product management. A proven record of scaling products to mass-market adoption within a multi-product ecosystem.

Mobile & Web Expertise: Deep experience driving user acquisition, retention, and monetization strategies for applications.

Lifecycle & Ecosystem Experience: Proficiency in managing complex LCM channels and growth loops. Hands-on experience with enterprise marketing automation infrastructure (e.g., Adobe Journey Optimizer) is highly preferred.

Quantitative Rigor: Strong analytical skills. Demonstrated capability in cohort analysis, funnel optimization, user profiling, and A/B/multivariate experiment development.

Technical & Creative Proficiency: Ability to translate GenAI capabilities (e.g., LLMs, diffusion models) into intuitive value propositions for creative professionals in building, video, and imaging.

Cross-Functional Leadership: Proven ability to influence executive collaborators, product managers, and engineering teams in a matrixed organization.

Are you interested in defining the future of creativity by making it fast, fun, and frictionless to create sophisticated-looking content? Most of all, are you passionate about the next generation of users and building modern solutions for them that connect to leading social and digital platforms?

Join the Adobe Express team of passionate storytellers, technology innovators, and change agents! We are now re-imagining the way people discover, create, and publish the full range of media types - from graphics to imaging to video - right in the browser and on their mobile devices. Our aim is to build fast and easy product experiences that empower students, social influencers, marketers, small businesses - really anyone with something to say - to make something that will stand out and impress their audience.

We are seeking a versatile, hands-on Engineering Manager to lead and grow a team of hardworking, high-impact engineers delivering experiences for industry-leading web applications. You’ll work closely with partners in business, design, and project management, and you’ll serve a team that is equally capable of giving and receiving technical guidance.

What you’ll do:

Lead and manage a team to build modern, well architected web and mobile apps, leveraging powerful web service technologies and Artificial Intelligence to build Adobe magic

Guide team through research, technical design, implementation, delivery, and maintenance of production services

Influence design decisions and technical direction for engineers, QE, product managers, user experience designers, and senior leaders

Write code samples, prototypes, and pseudocode to guide implementation

Promote modern technical standards

Incentivize quality code and effective communication

Maintain effective communication and collaboration with partner teams, both local and remote, in completing interdependent work items, and ensure transparency of project status to partners

Manage team member’s performance, employing ongoing performance feedback and coaching, identifying and making progress toward career development goals

Hire and train new engineers

Partner with designers and business leaders to provide a best-in-class customer experience

Engage with customers to understand problems, test ideas, and refine workflows

What you need to succeed:

At least 5 years of web application development, plus a minimum of 3+ years of managing engineers

BA/BS in computer science, or equivalent work experience

Experience developing world-class HTML, CSS, & JavaScript with Web Components, Vue, React, or equivalent frameworks

Experience developing cloud services with Java, Python or Node

Experience with AI tooling to improve code quality, tackle tech debt, and shorten dev cycles

Track record of designing and developing robust, scalable high impact web applications

Proficient with large scale web application design and development best practices to achieve modular, maintainable and extensible solutions

Bonus: Experience and knowledge in scalable content management system

Knowledge in test frameworks, code coverage, static code analysis tools

Operational experience running publicly available cloud services and applications, including AWS deployment/management services (CloudFormation, CloudWatch, etc.)

Consistent record of successful execution of the complete software development lifecycle

Demonstrated ability to learn new technologies and to maintain a high degree of technical involvement with your team

Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Ability to work cooperatively with people at all levels

Ambition and passion about building world-class productivity workflows

Experience leading or participating in agile software development

The Opportunity

Within the capacity of Lead Employee Relations Consultant (P50), you will operate as a high-level strategic advisor, problem-solver, and thought partner to leaders across Adobe. You will independently navigate the most critical, complex, and high visibility employee relations matters—including sensitive investigations, complex performance issues, conduct matters, conflict resolution, and escalations—while influencing leaders toward business-aligned, ethically grounded decisions!

You will shape organizational health by anticipating risks, synthesizing insights across regions, and driving proactive strategies that help leaders build resilient, engaged, and inclusive teams. You will partner closely with HR Business Partners, Employment Counsel, Employee Experience Centers of Excellence, and ER Managers to accelerate decision-making, elevate ER thinking, and ensure consistent outcomes that reinforce Adobe’s values.

This role is ideal for an expert who is as comfortable briefing executives as leading an investigation, and who can balance strategic foresight with operational excellence!

What you'll Do

Strategic Business Partnership & Organizational Enablement

Act as an experienced advisor to leaders, influencing decision making and proactively identifying people related risks, patterns, and opportunities for healthier team environments.

Translate business strategy into tailored ER approaches that reinforce accountability, improve team efficiency, and drive positive organizational outcomes.

Coach leaders through complex people challenges, building their capability to lead with clarity, fairness, consistency, and cultural alignment.

Partner with HRBPs and leadership groups regarding organizational themes, early warning signs, and workforce health indicators, enabling proactive interventions and scalable solutions.

2. Leadership of High Complexity Casework & Investigations

Lead sensitive, detailed, and high stakes workplace investigations, ensuring high-quality analysis, objectivity, thoroughness, and compliant processes.

Provide direction, guidance, and quality review on case strategy, documentation, findings, and recommendations.

Address the most intricate performance management and conduct matters, offering strategic recommendations rooted in risk assessment, cultural alignment, and business impact.

De-escalate issues that arise within the ecosystem.

3. Reorganizations & Workforce Transformation

Partner with leaders and HRBPs to guide the people related execution of reorganizations, team restructures, role changes, and other workforce transitions.

Advise on communication strategies, sequencing, change readiness, team impacts, and risk factors.

Identify root causes of organizational friction and develop ER strategies that support smoother transitions and long-term organizational effectiveness.

Ensure consistency of approach across regions while respecting local nuance.

4. Proactive ER Strategies & Organizational Health Insights

Analyze case trends, workplace dynamics, and team health indicators to deliver actionable insights, and partner with business and PX leadership to recommend proactive strategies—such as training, manager enablement, and process or behavior changes—to reduce risk and strengthen culture.

Partner with EWX and ELR leadership to activate priorities such as manager capability uplift, governance & documentation improvements, and scalable ER standards.

Lead continuous improvement efforts that simplify processes, strengthen decision quality, and reinforce global consistency.

5. Coaching, Influence & Thought Leadership

Serve in a senior ER capacity on cross‑functional initiatives, partnering closely with Legal, Security, HR Operations, PX, and Centers of Excellence.

Lead and participate in Americas and global ER projects, promoting regional alignment and uniformity in processes, communication standards, governance, and partner engagement while supporting scalable, adaptable solutions.

6. Cross Functional Leadership

Function as a senior ER representative on cross-functional initiatives, collaborating closely with Legal, Security, HR Operations, PX, and Centers of Excellence.

Lead and contribute to Americas and global ER projects, driving regional alignment and consistency in processes, communication standards, governance, and partner engagement while enabling scalable, adaptable solutions.

What you need to succeed

Deep expertise navigating high complexity ER matters across investigations, conduct, conflict, and performance.

Strong business insight and ability to align ER guidance to organizational objectives and business realities.

Exceptional judgment, analytical skills, and integrated thinking; ability to anticipate issues and shape early interventions.

Demonstrated success influencing leaders at multiple levels and driving outcomes in a global matrix environment.

Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to produce concise, executive ready summaries and high quality investigation documentation.

Ability to coach others, uplift team capability, and drive consistent, values aligned outcomes.

Experience partnering with cross functional teams on organizational change, de-escalation, governance, and critical initiatives.

Customer-facing Engineers who excel at solving complex technical challenges, delighting customers, and driving agent-based automation in a collaborative environment will thrive here. · Collaborate with Data architects, Enterprise architects, Solution consultants and Product engineering teams to capture customer data integration requirements, conceptualize solutions & build required technology stack

· Collaborate with enterprise customer's engineering team to identify data sources, profile and quantify quality of data sources, develop tools to prepare data and build data pipelines for integrating customer data sources and third party data sources with Adobe solutions

· Encourage team to think out-of-the-box and overcome engineering obstacles while incorporating new innovative design principles.

· Experience & knowledge with Adobe Experience Cloud solutions

The Opportunity

Adobe seeks a Senior or Principal Engineering Program Manager with strategic and execution skills to support Adobe Analytics Product and Engineering teams in meeting vital business targets. The role involves building and growing the next generation of Adobe Analytics products, especially emphasizing agentic capabilities in the Adobe Customer Experience Orchestration (CXO) portfolio.

You will operate in a highly complex, fast-evolving, and often ambiguous environment. The ideal candidate thrives in this setting — bringing structure to ambiguity, improving cross-functional alignment, and developing positive relationships across the organization. This is not a “task master” role. Serving as a reliable, hands-on partner embedded within the program team, you will work closely with Engineering, Product, UX, and Marketing leaders to drive outcomes.

You will be instrumental in advancing collaboration, communication, consistency in execution, and alignment within the CXO ecosystem — establishing yourself as a trusted and indispensable contributor. Experience leading software development programs and collaborating across Engineering, Product, and Marketing is essential.

If you feel driven to develop the future of Adobe’s analytical solutions in the emerging Agentic space, we’d love to meet you.

What you'll do:

Drive complex programs from concept through release.

Proactively identify risks, remove obstacles, and solve problems directly — taking ownership rather than waiting for direction.

Ensure strong operational hygiene across tools (JIRA, dashboards, status reporting).

Coordinate cross-functional dependencies across global teams, partnering closely with other Program Managers and collaborators.

Communicate program status, risks, and trade-offs.

Mentor peers, effect positive change, and lead by example.

What you need to succeed:

Deep sense of ownership and accountability — you operate like a business owner.

Technical curiosity — you seek to understand how systems work and leverage AI tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude, Codex) to accelerate insights and solutions.

Strong prioritization skills and the ability to complete tasks in a fast-paced, technically complex environment.

Strong interpersonal and communication abilities, capable of influencing various cross-functional groups and senior leadership.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, high attention to detail, and a focus on continuous improvement.

Proficiency in JIRA (basic), Confluence (basic), Excel (intermediate to advanced), and modern AI tooling.

10+ years of relevant experience, including engineering management and/or program management experience.

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required; advanced degree preferred.

PMP, CSM, or Agile certifications preferred.

Adobe Firefly’s Applied Science & Machine Learning (ASML) group is seeking research scientists and engineers passionate about conditional generation and editing of large-scale generative AI models. They will concentrate on images and videos. Our aim is to advance generative AI and ensure models have high quality and controllability.

We are especially seeking candidates experienced in large-scale, industry-grade pre-training and mid-training of multi-modality generative models. This role directly influences the quality of Adobe’s image and video generation models, supporting next-generation creative workflows for millions of users.

As an Applied Scientist at Adobe, you will join a world-class team of applied researchers and engineers building the future of digital experiences. You will have the opportunity to innovate across the full training stack, collaborate across data, modeling, and product, and see your work ship to customers worldwide.

Job Responsibilities

Conduct innovative research and development in training large-scale generative AI models for image and video synthesis.

Develop, carry out, and carefully evaluate sophisticated techniques for conditional generation and editing. This work emphasizes improving instruction adherence, controllability, and the visual quality of pre-trained image and video models.

Collaborate cross-functionally with researchers, engineers, and product teams to translate multimodal innovations into scalable downstream applications coordinated within Adobe products.

Define and build comprehensive evaluation frameworks and benchmarking pipelines to assess generative models across quality, efficiency, safety, and reliability, establishing guidelines and standards for the organization.

Translate research concepts and published work into production-ready implementations using Python and modern machine learning frameworks.

Collaborate with technical leads to build long-term technical strategy and roadmap, while mentoring and guiding junior engineers and researchers to elevate team capability and impact.

What you'll need to succeed

Hold a Master’s or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a closely related area.

Extensive practical experience in large-scale generative AI training emphasizing the creation and modification of images and videos.

Familiarity with diffusion models, transformers, or other brand new generative architectures.

Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate across cross-functional teams.

Strong coding and prototyping ability in Python, PyTorch, and ML infrastructure tools.

Working with product teams on technology transfers

Strong history of publications in Computer Science, AI/ML, or related areas

The Opportunity

Firefly Enterprise is bringing generative AI into real creative workflows—directly inside the tools customers already use. The Extensibility team builds and evolves GenStudio plugins (e.g., for Figma and other creative hosts) that connect in-product experiences to Firefly imaging workflows (generate image/similar, generative expand, remove background, etc.) and GenStudio enterprise workflows (templating/mapping, iteration, governance handoff).The problem we’re solving: enterprise creative teams want the speed of generative AI without leaving their native tools or rebuilding complex templates elsewhere. Today, moving between tools and web apps can break pixel-perfect designs, fragment iteration history, and make it harder to enforce enterprise guardrails. GenStudio plugins solve this by enabling in-tool generation and editing, mapping content to structured fields/roles (headline/body/CTA/on-image text), and handing off outputs to GenStudio for governance and activation—all while integrating with the right APIs and enterprise constraints.This role is frontend-first with basic full-stack expectations: you’ll mainly build UI and client architecture, and you’ll also be comfortable debugging service integrations, collaborating on API contracts, and making small backend contributions when needed.

What you’ll do

Build and ship GenStudio plugins using modern JavaScript/TypeScript and a contemporary frontend framework (React/Web Components or similar).

Own user-facing workflows end-to-end: UI implementation, interaction design fidelity, state management, performance, accessibility, and reliability.

Integrate deeply with APIs (REST/GraphQL): handle auth flows, async job orchestration (polling), retries, error states, and instrumentation-friendly patterns.

Design for extensibility: implement flexible UI patterns and plugin architecture that can grow to new workflows, new hosts, and enterprise requirements.

Work closely with Product and Design: clarify requirements, surface edge cases early, and iterate quickly with high-quality execution.

Champion engineering quality: unit/integration testing where appropriate, code reviews, build/release hygiene, and pragmatic tech debt management.

Mentor and support junior engineers through reviews, pairing, and design discussions.

What you need to succeed

6–8+ years of professional software engineering experience with a strong frontend focus.

Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and modern component-based UI development.

Proven experience integrating with APIs and building robust client-side systems around asynchronous workflows.

Strong CS fundamentals and practical software design skills.

Excellent communication skills; ability to collaborate across functions and time zones.

Nice to have

Experience building embedded/plugin UIs (Figma plugins, UXP panels, add-ins, extensions, or other constrained runtimes).

Basic backend experience (Node.js/services) and comfort working with logs/metrics and debugging cross-service issues.

Familiarity with LLMs/GenAI concepts and integrating AI capabilities into products.

Experience with build systems, CI/CD, and release processes (marketplace-style or enterprise deployments).

At P50, you’ll be a technical leader shaping the plugin platform and engineering practices for extensibility at scale. Set engineering direction on quality, performance, reliability, accessibility, and maintainability for plugin UI and integration layers.

Define and influence API contracts with backend/platform teams to ensure developer-friendly, scalable integrations.

Establish durable patterns for async workflows (job polling, progress UX, cancellation, retries, partial failures, and user trust).

Mentor and raise the bar: guide senior and junior engineers, run technical reviews, and create a culture of strong ownership and crisp execution.

Collaborate cross-functionally at a high level: align with PM/Design on roadmap, scope trade-offs, and extensible product design.

Strong experience integrating with REST/GraphQL APIs, handling auth and async workflows, and designing resilient client systems.

Ability to provide technical leadership, navigate ambiguity, and communicate clearly with engineering and product leadership.

The Opportunity

At least 5 years of practical experience developing products 

Strong computer science background (data structures, algorithms).

Very good knowledge of OOP and design patterns 

Knowledge of web technologies and standards 

Familiarity with 2D graphics paradigms 

Experience with Agile development processes 

Committed to the highest levels of quality, experienced on test automation (Unit testing, Integration testing) 

A sharp eye for security related issues and performance bottlenecks 

Proficiency in English, both writing and speaking

The Opportunity 

We’re the market leader in software products and services that power the world’s creative, document, and marketing ecosystems — from Creative Cloud and Document Cloud to Firefly, Express, and Experience Cloud. Over 85% of the Fortune 2000 rely on Adobe to fuel creativity, collaboration, and transformation.

As AI reshapes the creative and media landscape, Adobe stands at the intersection of creativity, marketing, and artificial intelligence — making us a trusted partner to CEOs, CMOs, CTOs, Studio executives, key talent and known directors as well as the next generation of creative and business leaders.

We are looking for an incredible individual to drive thought leadership, innovation, and commercial partnerships that inspire and accelerate enterprise adoption of GenAI in creativity, film and enterprises.

We’re looking for a rare hybrid — a technically fluent creative leader with deep roots in filmmaking, Hollywood, YouTube, or digital storytelling — who knows how to bridge art and technology to open doors, build partnerships, and create momentum in the market.

This person will be equal parts technologist, storyteller, and dealmaker — passionate about shaping the future of creativity, and skilled at translating innovation into business impact.

A successful candidate will have the technical AI chops to be respected by our eng and researchers, strong c-level relationship building skills, an ability to rally internal cross-functional partners and a founder mentality.

What You’ll Do

Ignite new business and partnerships: Lead Firefly Foundry engagements from concept to commercial deal, collaborating with Adobe’s enterprise sales and creative leadership teams.

Bridge creative vision with technology: Translate the needs of filmmakers, studios, creators, and brands into Foundry use cases that showcase “the art of the possible.”

Shape Adobe’s role in the entertainment and creator ecosystem: Build trusted relationships across studios, media companies, YouTube creators, agencies, and enterprise partners.

Advise and evangelize: Serve as a GenAI authority and creative industry leader with vision — presenting at customer meetings, partner events, and major conferences.

Collaborate across the enterprise: Work closely with Adobe Research, Firefly engineering, marketing, and product teams to test, validate, and influence future product directions.

Be hands-on: Prototype creative solutions, demo Firefly APIs and integrations, and bring ideas to life with tangible visual and storytelling proof points.

What you'll need to succeed

10+ years of experience across creative technology, media, entertainment, or enterprise partnerships.

A strong mix of technical fluency (AI, creative tools, APIs, cloud platforms) and creative depth (film, video, digital storytelling, YouTube, or content production).

Proven success launching or scaling products or experiences — ideally in a startup, 0→1, or innovation lab environment.

A network in the entertainment and creator ecosystem — and the confidence to navigate C-suite, studio, and creator conversations.

Entrepreneurial outlook: a “player-coach” who rolls up their sleeves and thrives in ambiguity.

High EQ, low ego, and a natural ability to connect teams, ideas, and opportunities.

Comfort operating as both strategist and creative technologist, who can drive both impact and storytelling.

Great teammate (roll up your sleeves, adaptable work style, lead via influence, excellent “connector”)

We are seeking a Staff Engineer - AI for Engineering to design and build the next-generation AI systems that bring intelligent, adaptive, and agentic experiences to Adobe Express.

This role is ideal for an engineer who deeply understands how modern LLMs and generative models behave in real-world systems — including reasoning patterns, tool use, prompt dynamics, failure modes, and orchestration strategies — and can translate that understanding into scalable, production-ready platforms.

You will define and build the end-to-end architecture that enables Agentic AI solutions solving real engineering problems— spanning model orchestration, tool integration, memory systems, inference services, data flows, evaluation loops, and real-time decision systems.

This is a systems-first AI role focused on building intelligent platforms.

What You’ll Do

A core part of this role is building scalable Agentic AI platforms that empower developers, significantly boost engineering productivity, and accelerate AI adoption across the organization.

Architect and evolve the AI platform powering Adobe Engineering — with a strong emphasis on Agentic AI systems and LLM-native architectures.

Design and implement scalable orchestration layers that coordinate LLMs, tools, APIs, memory stores, and multi-step reasoning workflows.

Build production-grade agent frameworks that support planning, task decomposition, tool invocation, multi-agent collaboration, and persistent memory.

Develop high-performance inference and runtime systems with strong guarantees around latency, reliability, observability, and cost efficiency.

Design evaluation and feedback systems that measure reasoning quality, task success, hallucination rates, and agent behavior — enabling rapid iteration and continuous improvement.

Integrate first-party and third-party foundation models into cohesive, adaptive systems using routing, model selection, guardrails, and fallback strategies.

Design data flows, session-level intelligence, and contextual memory systems that allow agents to operate coherently across interactions.

Partner with applied research, product, and platform teams to bring intelligent agentic capabilities into real developer-facing experiences.

Drive architectural strategy for AI for Engineering — connecting models, reasoning engines, tools, and data streams into adaptive AI systems.

Mentor senior engineers in modern AI system design, LLM orchestration patterns, and agent platform architecture.

What You’ll Bring

10+ years of experience building large-scale distributed systems, AI platforms, or intelligent service architectures.

Deep understanding of how LLMs behave in production environments — including prompting strategies, reasoning chains, tool usage, grounding techniques, hallucination mitigation, guardrails, and evaluation patterns.

Strong experience building AI-powered systems using LLM orchestration frameworks, model routing strategies, and multi-model pipelines.

Hands-on experience designing agentic systems — including reasoning loops, memory persistence, tool integration, state management, and multi-agent coordination.

Proven expertise in building scalable, cloud-native, microservices-based architectures with strong observability and reliability.

Experience designing evaluation systems for generative AI quality, task completion, and behavioral robustness.

Proficiency in TypeScript, Python and at least one systems language (Java, Go, C++), with experience building production AI services.

Strong systems thinking — ability to connect model capabilities, runtime constraints, and product requirements into coherent architectures.

Excellent multi-functional communication skills, with experience influencing architectural direction across research and engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience architecting AI assistants, copilots, or agent platforms in production environments.

Experience working with multimodal generative systems (text, image, video, motion).

Familiarity with tool-augmented LLM systems, RAG architectures, vector databases, and contextual memory systems.

Exposure to evaluation frameworks for generative AI quality and safety.

Experience contributing to open-source AI frameworks or publishing technical thought leadership.

Opportunity

As a Senior Customer Experience Orchestration Data Architect at Adobe, you will lead the development of advanced, secure data solutions for our innovative digital marketing platforms. We craft data strategy, architecture, SQL and governance for customer solutions, including end-to-end profiles, segmentation, journeys, and campaigns!

What You’ll Do

Provide deep experience to build data solutions across multiple Adobe products and cloud platforms aligned with enterprise data strategy.

Engage closely with customers and Adobe team to facilitate data discovery by evaluating systems and business processes. Analyze customer sources, data movement, data granularity, relationships, data format, etc.

Unify disparate data (e.g., sales, CRM, analytics data, etc.) to meet customers’ digital marketing use cases. Lead and develop conceptual, logical, and physical data models for multi-solution delivery.

Establish frameworks for data quality, define standards, master data management, data services, data governance, data modeling, tools, data security, privacy, and compliance with industry regulations (PII, PCI, HIPAA, GDPR, etc.).

We develop and champion data architecture guidelines via detailed documentation. These encompass architectural blueprints, ERDs, data flow diagrams, source-to-target mappings, data dictionaries, metadata catalogs, governance frameworks, guardrails, and security and compliance protocols.

We engage with cross-disciplinary groups and Adobe professionals to identify customer demands. We provide data layout and strategic blueprints, advocating for scalable, secure resolutions. Assume the role of a liaison to promptly tackle technical obstacles.

We develop strategies for growing data volumes, tools, and integrations, while aligning with customers’ objectives.

We deliver mentorship on data architecture to customers and consultants to align work with targets.

We deliver Adobe platform data lake and real-time customer profile to get ready for data ingestion and activation. Employ REST APIs, Postman, and basic scripting to automate and streamline the implementation and setup.

Develop and construct data ingestion solutions for streaming and batch processing, online and offline data within AEP. Collaborate with data engineers to develop and implement ETL/ELT pipelines for data collection and extraction.

We improve data query performance across platforms by tuning models and adhering to guidelines and ensure product guardrails are followed and deployed in solutions

Requirements

Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, or a related field or equivalent experience.

10+ years of data architecture, modeling, SQL, and working with customers!

Expert proficiency in crafting customer-centric database models, datasets (e.g., CRM, Call Center, Marketing, Offline, Point of Sale, etc.) with relational, hierarchical (e.g., RDBMS, Columnar, Data Warehouse, BI, Document, Semantic layer modeling, Data Lakes, OLTP & OLAP, etc.).

Advanced skills in SQL development (e.g., functions, data transformations, arrays, joins details, stored procedures, data analysis).

Deep experience in translating business requirements into scalable data architecture by conducting structured analysis of data workflows and processes

Demonstrate outstanding organizational skills and ability to balance customer projects concurrently with strong verbal, written communication skills and previous experience with customer-facing engagements

Special Consideration given for

Hands-on use or administration of Adobe Experience Platform (AEP)

Deep domain expertise in one or more industries (Retail, Telecom, Healthcare, Automotive, Cloud and Streaming platforms, etc.)

Experience with programming languages (e.g., Python or Bash scripting)

The Opportunity 

Adobe is seeking a visionary Director of Global Enterprise Events Narrative to redefine how we tell our AI story across global events, where strategic, high-impact conversations happen with global brands, C-suite decision makers, and industry thought leaders. This is a high-profile, strategic role that plays a critical part in advancing Adobe’s enterprise narrative and strengthening executive relationships across industries.

In this role, you will craft and steward the overarching story that connects Adobe’s innovation, vision, and technology at key events globally. You’ll collaborate closely with global and regional stakeholders to bring Adobe’s innovation and impact to life through compelling, customer-centric keynotes, breakouts, and event presence.

The ideal candidate combines strategic storytelling expertise with a strong executive presence, thrives in high-visibility environments, and brings a track record of building and scaling events with professionalism, clarity, and impact.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Define, own, and evolve the global enterprise events narrative. Define a clear, compelling overarching event narrative that elevates Adobe’s presence across all global enterprise events, ensuring consistency, clarity, and strategic alignment, while enabling flexibility for regional, industry, and audience-specific relevance.

Translate enterprise strategy into event storytelling. Partner with enterprise marketing, product marketing, sales, and executive leadership to translate Adobe’s enterprise vision, AI innovation, and customer value into powerful event moments (keynotes, sessions, panels, exec engagements, booth experiences, and more) for key customer groups

Lead keynote development and narrative strategy across the enterprise events ecosystem. Help write and shape high-impact keynote narratives and speaker briefs, ensuring narrative cohesion across the full event ecosystem (flagship events, industry trade shows, regional forums, executive roundtables, speaking opportunities to name a few), ensuring every moment ladders back to the same story.

Partner closely with regional and industry teams. Collaborate with regional marketing, industry marketing, and field teams to adapt the global narrative for local markets, balancing global consistency with cultural, industry, and audience nuance.

Scale storytelling excellence globally. Create repeatable narrative frameworks, templates, and enablement tools that empower teams worldwide to execute consistently and with high quality at scale 

Measure and refine narrative impact. Partner with analytics and marketing teams to assess narrative performance and audience engagement, using insights and feedback to continuously evolve the story.

QUALIFICATIONS

12+ years of experience in enterprise storytelling, event strategy, brand narrative, or executive communications, with a strong focus on global and large-scale events

Proven experience owning and scaling event narratives globally, including adapting a core story across regions, industries and audience types

Demonstrated expertise in writing executive keynotes and shaping key speaking moments for senior leaders

Deep familiarity with the full event ecosystem: flagship conferences, industry trade shows, executive forums, panels, speaking engagements, and more

Exceptional storytelling, writing, and presentation skills, with proven ability to simplify complex technology and business value into compelling narratives that resonate with key customer groups

Strong executive presence and comfort with working in highly visible, fast-paced, ambiguous environments

Proven experience working closely with cross-functional teams across regions and industries

The Opportunity

Are you interested in shaping a scalable Security Compliance Program for APAC region while collaborating with global teams? As the Sr. Compliance Product Owner at Adobe in Sydney, you'll be part of Adobe's Technology GRC (Tech GRC) team focusing on driving Australian Security Compliances, collaborating with external assessors, government agencies, product development & operations teams, core security teams, and others. This is your chance to create an outstanding impact and ensure sales go through optimally for a product-based organization!

What you’ll do

Build and maintain scalable processes to support security compliance across the APAC region, ensuring alignment with global standards and unified compliance strategies.

Translate security compliance requirements into actionable programs, including gap analyses, remediation plans, and implementation of necessary security controls.

Perform IRAP Readiness Assessment covering various cybersecurity guidelines of the Information Security Manual (ISM) for products seeking IRAP assessment.

Draft compliance reports to detail the compliance objectives, key findings, and work with teams to remediate key findings

Present Readiness Assessment result reports to summarize compliance goals, main insights, and next steps to partners and management regularly.

Coordinate the development of System Security Plan (SSP) documents for in-scope products

Liaising with external auditors and customers to help them gain comfort with regard to Adobe’s security compliance program.

Review and coordinate Cloud Controls Matrix (CCM) updates and IRAP Cloud Security Assessment Report (IRAP Report) with assessors.

Work under the supervision and support of the Tech GRC manager and drive technology compliance activities across Adobe.

What you need to succeed:

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Information Security/Cyber Security or related field.

Minimum 5 years of related security compliance assessments, IT/Cloud auditing, and control testing experience.

Proven knowledge of Security Compliance frameworks such as IRAP, Cyber Essential Eight, ISMAP, ISO 270xx, SOC 2, etc.

Strong auditing background, technical expertise, and deep knowledge of information security controls including but not limited to SDLC, Cryptography, Identity/User Access management, Backup and DR processes will be useful

Knowledge of cloud infrastructure like AWS, Azure, GCP, along with hands on experience

Good interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills. It is essential that the candidate is a team-player and possesses strong organizational and planning skills

Ability to anticipate questions, independently assess risk, and think critically and creatively.

Ability to work closely with others in a fast-paced environment.

Relevant security related certifications (e.g., CISA, IRAP Assessor) are a plus.
