Join our team at Adobe, where creativity and innovation blend with collaboration, and legal minds lead the way in shaping the future. Seeking an Associate Legal Counsel who is sharp, savvy, and prepared to excel in our dynamic team.

We are looking for a recently qualified or early-career lawyer (0–2 years PQE) admitted to the Bar Association, eager to build their in-house career and make a meaningful contribution to our operations within the Central (Eastern Europe) and Iberia (Spain and Portugal) regions. You will be supported and mentored by the Managing Counsel and the wider legal team as you develop your in-house expertise.

Why Join Us?

A Legal Team Like No Other: Supportive, encouraging, and—above all—friendly. We lift each other up, share knowledge freely, and always find time to celebrate wins (big or small).

Diversity & Inclusion: We champion every voice, celebrate every background, and believe that brilliant ideas come from everywhere.

Work/Life Balance: We know life is more than work. Flexible schedules and hybrid options are here to keep you energized.

Competitive Salary & Benefits: A comprehensive compensation package intended to support and reward employees.

Growth & Opportunity: Adobe is rapidly growing, and so can you. Structured mentoring and a clear development path are built into this role. Get involved in crafting new systems (think: AI chatbots, CLM, knowledge sharing, automation) and work processes.

The challenge 

Build your in-house legal career by supporting our dynamic sales team and working alongside colleagues in marketing, finance, procurement, and beyond. Under the guidance of our Managing Counsel, you will develop into a trusted legal partner for the Central and Iberia Regions.

What You’ll Do

Draft, Review & Negotiate: Work and negotiate on a variety of agreements—license, professional services, consulting, statements of work, resale, distribution, sales, and licensing. You’ll keep us covered and keep deals moving.

Commercial Legal Support: Partner with our business units, providing timely, commercial advice and delivering in-house training on the legal topics that matter most. Help demystify law for your colleagues!

Compliance Monitor: Monitor and flag relevant regulatory and legal developments — particularly in technology, AI, intellectual property, and data privacy — and support senior counsel in analysing their impact on Adobe.

Drive Process Improvement: Dive into knowledge management and help evolve our legal processes. Lead departmental projects that make us better, smarter, and faster.

Embrace Legal Technology: Use AI-assisted tools for contract analysis, research, and document drafting as part of your day-to-day workflow. Develop hands-on fluency in the technologies that are reshaping how legal services are delivered — no prior experience required, just a genuine curiosity about what’s coming next.

Project Legal Support: Join working groups as new projects and business practices are developed, bringing your legal and business perspective where it’s needed most.

Ongoing Training & Risk Management: Carry out internal training sessions, and offer continuous support on key risks—building a culture of compliance and confidence.

What you need to succeed

Qualified Lawyer: Admitted to the Bar Association with 0–2 years PQE. In-house or law firm experience is welcome; we are equally open to recently qualified candidates who are the right fit.

Commercial/IT/IP Interest: You have foundational knowledge or a strong interest in commercial, technology, or IP law — gained through studies, internships, or early practice. You have an appetite to deepen your understanding of the complexities of software, technology, and data protection in a fast-moving tech company.

Business and Risk Savvy: You see the bigger picture and understand how legal matters fit into business objectives, assess, and manage risks across multiple matters at once.

Communication Skills: You have strong drafting ability and good attention to detail, and you can translate complex legalese into everyday plain language.

Languages: Proficient in English and Romanian (required). Spanish or Portuguese is a genuine advantage given the Iberia scope of the role.

Flexible & Adaptable: You’re quick on your feet, ready to adjust when the business demands change.

What Makes This Role Fun & Cool?

Build the Future: Play a key role in Adobe’s evolution, especially in this fast-paced tech and AI culture.

Tech Meets Law: Dive into brand new systems and technology incorporating AI, CLM, and automation—assist us in scaling smarter!

Room to Grow: Take on new challenges, lead projects, collaborate with a distributed team, and develop your own expertise as Adobe expands.

Fun Perks: Celebrations, creativity challenges, and team-building events—plus some of the best colleagues in the business.

Role Description

Adobe Advertising is evolving to deliver agentic experiences that simplify workflows. We’re hiring a senior engineer to own testing of known systems, automation frameworks, and end‑to‑end system validation. You will build the tooling and test infrastructure that ensures reliability, performance, and quality across complex distributed systems.

What You’ll Do

Own end‑to‑end system test strategy, execution, and release sign‑off.

Build test frameworks known for their use of deep knowledge of system internals.

Build and implement automation tooling for APIs, services, and UI flows.

Build reusable test harnesses, simulators, and stubs for system dependencies.

Drive integration, regression, and non‑functional testing (latency, scale, resiliency).

Implement CI/CD test pipelines and quality gates across environments.

Analyze failures, triage defects, and improve system observability.

Collaborate with product, platform, SRE, and engineering teams on quality plans.

Mentor team members and champion a quality‑first engineering culture.

What You Bring

5-8 years of experience in system testing, automation, or tooling engineering.

Strong skills in testing known systems and ability to test complex architectures.

Hands‑on experience building automation frameworks (Python, Playwright/Selenium/BDD).

Proven work on API, integration, and distributed system testing.

Solid system build and debugging skills; comfortable with ambiguity.

CI/CD experience and infrastructure knowledge (Docker/Kubernetes preferred).

Strong communication skills and ability to work together across various functions.

Nice to Have

Exposure to GenAI/LLM evaluation techniques, timely testing, or RAG validation.

Experience with Langfuse, LangSmith, or AWS Bedrock evaluations.

Observability/telemetry and experiment analytics experience.

Prior work on internal developer platforms or tooling.

Why Adobe

Join a team building critical automation and validation infrastructure that directly develops the reliability of Adobe Advertising’s next‑generation agentic systems.

The Personalization and Campaign office is redefining how direct sales at Adobe plans, implements, and scales market engagement strategies using AI. We sit at the intersection of strategy, data, content, and frontline execution, translating business intent into always-on, highly personalized customer experiences across inbound and outbound sales motions.

We are looking for a skilled Copywriter with deep prompt engineering expertise to help power this transformation. This role is critical to how we build, test, and scale messaging. The messaging uses advanced technology and feels human, relevant, and effective throughout the customer journey. The customer journey. You will develop the content, prompts, and narratives that drive performance across agentic workflows, campaigns, and sales experiences.

As a Campaign Content Manager, Applied AI, you will specialize in crafting high-impact content and prompts that fuel AI agents used across sales and marketing workflows. You will work closely with Strategy and operations, Market introduction, Product Marketing, Sales Operations, Campaign Managers, and AI Engineers to build personalized content that adapts to context, audience, and intent, at scale.

Key Responsibilities

Build and author copy and prompts for sales and GTM use cases, including outbound email campaigns, nurture sequences, in-product messaging, chat experiences, and sales assisted workflows and pitches.

Build, test, and refine prompts that enable AI agents to generate high-quality, on-brand, context-aware content across multiple scenarios.

Partner with Product Marketing and GTM teams to translate positioning, value propositions, and campaign strategy into scalable prompt frameworks.

Drive experimentation for AI-generated content, including A/B testing, multivariate testing, and performance analysis across segments and channels.

Optimize messaging for personalization at scale, demonstrating firmographic, behavioral, and contextual signals.

Maintain prompt libraries, messaging frameworks, and documentation to ensure consistency, quality, and reuse.

Collaborate with engineering and analytics partners to continuously improve output quality, speed, and relevance.

Stay current on emerging guidelines in prompt engineering, AI-assisted copywriting, and agentic content systems.

Qualifications / Experience

6+ years of experience in B2B SaaS copywriting, content strategy, or product marketing, with direct exposure to sales-focused use cases.

Proven experience with prompt engineering for LLM-powered systems, including writing, testing, and refining prompts.

Strong understanding of SaaS go to market motions, including inbound, outbound, lifecycle marketing, and sales enablement.

Hands-on experience running content experiments, A/B tests, and using data to inform iteration and optimization.

Exceptional writing skills with the ability to adapt tone, voice, and structure across audiences, segments and funnel stages.

Highly detailed and driven by a strong passion for action in fast paced environments.

Deep passion for personalization and customer relevance at scale

Comfortable partnering cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Marketing, Analytics, and Engineering teams, open to feedback, and motivated by shared iteration.

The Opportunity

Firefly Engineering is building the next generation of AI-native creative experiences across Adobe. We operate like a fast-moving startup inside Adobe—rapid iterations, bold bets, and obsessively high product quality. Our charter is to bring cutting-edge generative AI and LLM-driven capabilities directly into the hands of millions of creators.

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer who can build delightful AI-powered experiences end-to-end. You’ll work across UI, backend, and AI orchestration layers—connecting Firefly models, LLMs, and creative tooling into seamless, high-impact customer workflows.

This role sits at the intersection of creativity, engineering craftsmanship, and applied AI.

Impact You’ll Make

You thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving spaces and can take a feature from a sketch to production. You will help define how users interact with Firefly-powered capabilities across surfaces—whether that’s crafting elegant UI components, building robust backend services, or integrating with advanced generative models.

This role involves direct management and growth of a cross-functional engineering team. You will balance hands-on technical support with leading the team and overseeing delivery. You will collaborate closely with product, design, data, and business team members. It is a great chance for a strong full-stack engineer ready to transition into management. You will gain support and mentorship while building key leadership skills and advancing the platform into a stable, high-performance base for Adobe's internal users.

Key Responsibilities

Lead, mentor, and support a high-performing engineering team. Participate in hiring, onboarding, performance discussions, and career growth conversations. Build a collaborative, inclusive team culture with guidance from senior leadership.

Guide technical architecture and design decisions for the platform tracking critical metrics. Stay hands-on when necessary with frontend (Vue.js), backend (Node.js + Fastify), data layer (ClickHouse, Redis), and deployment (Azure Container Apps).

Partner with product managers to define and complete the engineering roadmap. Prioritize features, address technical debt, improve performance and scalability, and enhance reliability to deliver business value.

Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, design sessions, and technical planning to uphold high standards of code quality, maintainability, security, and performance.

Champion guidelines in software development, including testing, CI/CD, observability, and secure cloud deployments (e.g., VNet integration in Azure).

Support and exemplify efficient use of AI-based coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude/Claude Code) to hasten development, refactoring, and innovation—while reviewing outputs carefully.

Collaborate closely with cross-functional partners (product, UX/design, data analysts, DevOps, business collaborators) to turn requirements into engineering plans, remove blockers, and deliver iteratively.

Track team velocity, quality metrics, and system health; facilitate retrospectives and drive continuous improvement with support from leadership.

Handle sprint/quarter planning, resource coordination, risk identification, and delivery commitments for platform work.

Remain informed about progress in Vue.js, Node.js/Fastify, analytics databases (ClickHouse), caching (Redis), container platforms (Azure Container Apps), AI-assisted development, and data trends to support team decisions.

Required Qualifications

5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong hands-on work in frontend and backend technologies (e.g., Vue.js or similar modern JS frameworks + Node.js/TypeScript).

Prior technical leadership experience (e.g., tech lead, project lead, mentoring juniors, or owning major features/systems), with readiness and enthusiasm to transition into direct people management.

Experience contributing to full-stack delivery in production, ideally with data-heavy or analytics applications (e.g., dashboards, important metrics, observability tools). Practical experience working with AI-driven coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude/Claude Code) in everyday tasks, and enthusiasm for supporting the group in integrating them efficiently.

Solid understanding of contemporary software approaches: agile methods, CI/CD, testing (unit/integration/E2E), observability, and secure cloud deployments (Azure preferred).

Strong communication and collaboration abilities; capable of working alongside product, design, and non-technical colleagues to align engineering with business objectives.

Demonstrated potential for people leadership: mentoring others, giving feedback, and contributing to team culture.

Solid problem-solving skills and comfort navigating ambiguity in evolving, data-focused platforms.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with internal tools, enterprise analytics/benchmark systems, or B2E platforms.

Familiarity with real-time data, event streaming, or OLAP workloads.

Exposure to Azure services (Container Apps, VNet, Monitor) and IaC (Bicep/Terraform).

Background in frontend data visualization, backend optimization, or AI-assisted workflows.

Previous mentoring or informal leadership in scaling features or small projects.

What We Offer

Leadership of a high-visibility internal platform that influences organizational decisions.

Opportunity to grow as a manager in a supportive, innovative environment with mentorship from senior leaders.

Hands-on technical involvement while developing people-leadership skills.

Competitive salary and benefits packages.

Job Description- Enterprise Architect

Position Summary

As an Adobe Enterprise Architect, you will define and deliver enterprise scale digital

experience architectures that leverage Adobe Experience Cloud, AI/ML capabilities, and

modern cloud platforms. You will partner with senior business and technology leaders to

shape strategy, architecture roadmaps, and operating models that drive measurable customer

and business outcomes.

You will combine deep enterprise architecture expertise with AI, data, and cloud-native

experience to design future-ready solutions: from customer data foundations and decisioning

to personalized, omnichannel experiences. As a trusted advisor, you will guide clients through

digital, data, and AI transformation, ensuring alignment between business goals, technology

investments, and delivery teams.

Success in this role is measured by customer value and adoption, quality and feasibility of

architectures, clarity of roadmaps, impact on KPIs, and depth of trusted relationships rather

than billable hours alone.

The Opportunity

Digital is disrupting traditional business models and reshaping every stage of the customer

lifecycle. Leading organizations are turning to Adobe Experience Cloud and AI-powered

experiences to stay ahead.

Adobe’s Enterprise Architecture team is a dynamic group of senior consultants who:

• Partner with executives to define digital, data, and AI strategies.

• Design integrated architectures that connect content, data, insights, and activation.

• Help clients adopt cloud-native, API-first, and event-driven patterns on platforms such

as Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Cloud solutions, and public cloud

providers.

As an Enterprise Architect, you will use your knowledge of digital marketing technology,

AI/ML capabilities, and enterprise architecture to:

• Create strategic roadmaps for digital experience and AI innovation.

• Lead clients as a subject matter expert.

• Serve as a trusted advisor across business, data, and technology stakeholders.

What you'll Do

• Shape digital, data, and AI strategy

o Partner with executive and senior client stakeholders to define digital experience,

customer data, and AI/ML goals.

o Translate business vision into actionable multi-year architecture roadmaps

encompassing Adobe solutions, data/ML platforms, and cloud services.

o Identify key business drivers, KPIs, and value hypotheses to prioritize use cases

(e.g., personalization, journey orchestration, next-best action, marketing

optimization).

• Design enterprise and solution architectures

o Design end-to-end architectures across Adobe Experience Cloud and client

ecosystems.

o Define AI- and data-centric architectures, including: Customer data platforms,

identity, and profile management.

o Data ingestion, quality, governance, and activation patterns. Recommend futurestate

technology architectures using cloud-native principles (API-first,

microservices, event-driven, serverless) across Azure, AWS, and/or other public

clouds.

o Define reference architectures and patterns for secure, scalable cloud

deployments. Zero-trust, identity, and access management. Observability and

reliability.

• Drive alignment and governance

o Ensure alignment between business strategies, enterprise architecture, and

delivery teams across marketing, product, data, and IT.

o Define governance, operating models, and ways of working (e.g., architecture

review processes, decision forums, standards) to support sustainable adoption of

Adobe capabilities.

o Act as a liaison between Adobe teams, client business owners, IT, data/analytics,

and external partners for the full lifecycle of the engagement.

• Communicate and evangelize

o Communicate architecture options, trade-offs, and recommendations to C-level

and senior leadership using clear narratives, visuals, and value framing.

o Lead workshops, visioning sessions, and roadmap presentations that evangelize

AI and data driven digital experiences.

o Advocate for the Enterprise Architecture function and your work within the larger

Adobe Consulting organization and with clients.

• Contribute to practice growth

o Capture and codify reusable assets (reference architectures, patterns, templates,

accelerators).

o Mentor other architects and consultants on enterprise, AI, and cloud architecture

best practices.

o Support pre-sales activities (e.g., solutioning, estimations, proposals, executive

presentations) to position Adobe and EA services.

o

What you need to succeed

• proven record to develop enterprise architecture models.

• Validated experience with architecture frameworks such as API, SOA, and TOGAF

• Understanding & experience with public cloud architecture and services (Microsoft

Azure / Amazon AWS).

• Experience designing or integrating AI-powered customer experiences, including

working with LLM-based services and understanding core concepts such as prompt

design, RAG, and model evaluation strategies.

• Ability to collaborate with data/ML teams to define AI solution patterns and

guardrails, including basic awareness of agentic workflows and tool using agents, and

how they impact reliability, observability, and governance in enterprise environments.

• Experience from working with the Adobe Experience Cloud or at least one of its

solutions & Previous experience with other Digital Marketing platforms. (Good to

have).

• Experience communicating across senior leadership.

• Ability to intake client business vision and translate to technical solution and

architecture requirements.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills communicating deliverables, sharing

information, and leading meetings.

• Ability to communicate and lead execution of architecture vision across multifunctional

technical and strategy teams.

• Experience working with software engineers, data architects, application developers &

data scientists to plan out end-to-end solutions

• Understanding the solutions and systems that support it.

• Ability to communicate technical and business strategy optimally to audiences of

varying levels of experience, background, and seniority.

• Ability to travel a minimum of up to 50%.

At Adobe, you will be immersed in an exceptional work environment that is recognized

throughout the world on Best Companies lists. You will also be surrounded by colleagues who

are committed to helping each other grow through our unique Check-In approach where

ongoing feedback flows freely.

If you’re looking to make an impact, Adobe's the place for you. Discover what our employees

are saying about their career experiences on the Adobe Life blog and explore the meaningful

benefits we offer.

Job Title: Enterprise Deal Strategy Consultant – Finance

Role Summary

As an Enterprise Deal Strategy Consultant, you will be the decisive authority on deal approvals within the EMEA region. Your role will be pivotal in ensuring that customer proposals and contracts align with our strategic goals and financial principles. You will coordinate and manage the Enterprise C&P business, providing senior leadership with valuable insights and analysis on customer trends, deal structures, and product information. This is an outstanding opportunity to significantly influence Adobe's financial strategy while collaborating with cross-functional teams to develop scalable solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Deal Review, Approval & Rejection

Serve as the primary EDS approver for EMEA Enterprise deals.

Review deal structures for compliance with pricing, discounting, margin, and booking policies.

Approve or reject deals based on strategic alignment and commercial viability.

Document decisions and provide clear rationale for approvals or rejections.

Advance deals that exceed authority thresholds with detailed recommendations.

Governance & Decision Quality

Enforce consistent application of approval policies across EMEA.

Ensure decisions protect long-term revenue integrity and customer value.

Balance sales objectives with risk management through effective decision-making.

Maintain comprehensive documentation for all deal approvals.

Deal Desk Team Partnership

Partner with the Deal Desk to deliver timely and accurate assessments on customer proposals

Ensure high-quality information, analysis, and documentation is maintained observing best practises.

Review and provide feedback to ensure decision quality for output.

Quarterly Deal Analysis & Executive Reporting

Provide and present quarterly insights on EMEA deal activity, including trends and risk analysis.

Leverage data and formulate actionable reports for leadership.

Identify and recommend adjustments to policies and pricing based on recurring issues.

Strategise go-to-market with future requirements.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Communicate approval outcomes and rationale with Sales leadership.

Collaborate with Finance, Legal, and Revenue Operations on critical issues.

Ensure regional consistency in deal governance by aligning with global leadership.

Required Qualifications

Degree or equivalent experience in Finance, Business, Economics, or a related field.

7–10+ years of background in Deal Desk, Revenue Operations, or Finance.

Demonstrated experience in roles with deal approval responsibility.

Strong understanding of complex deal structures and EMEA commercial practices.

Preferred Experience

Experience working within global or matrixed organisations.

Knowledge of revenue recognition principles.

Proficiency with Dynamics and CPQ tools.

key Skills & Proficiencies

Decisive judgment and ability to challenge where necessary.

Strong financial competence and risk assessment skills.

Executive-level communication with data storytelling.

Attention to detail and a strong governance approach.

Ability to influence and initiate discussions.

Success Metrics

Uniformity and excellence in approval decisions.

Clear reasoning behind deal approval and rejection.

Reduction in policy deviations.

Punctuality and standard of Deal Desk deliverables.

Influence of quarterly deal insights.

Leadership confidence in EMEA deal governance.

The Opportunity

At Adobe, we believe creativity changes the world. We empower people and organizations to imagine bigger, move faster, and deliver exceptional digital experiences—grounded in a culture of innovation, inclusion, and trust.

We are seeking a Sales Leader for JAPAC within Adobe Digital Advertising, Learning & Publishing (DALP). This role owns and scales Adobe Learning Manager (ALM) and AEM Guides, two strategic platforms at the core of Adobe’s enterprise learning and technical publishing portfolio.

Adobe Learning Manager (ALM) enables enterprises to upskill employees, partners, and customers through personalized, AI-powered learning and advanced analytics. AEM Guides is Adobe’s cloud-native CCMS for creating, managing, and publishing structured technical content at scale with speed and consistency.

This is a strategic leadership role with end-to-end responsibility for accelerating ALM and AEM Guides across JAPAC, driving enterprise learning and documentation transformation, and building future strategic account leadership within Adobe.

This role reports to the Director of Sales, APAC & EMEA

What You’ll Do

· Own the JAPAC number. Carry full responsibility for revenue, bookings, pipeline coverage, and forecast accuracy for ALM and AEM Guides

· Build a world-class sales organization. Hire, coach, and scale a high-performance JAPAC team with a strong succession bench

· Operate with precision. Instill disciplined pipeline rigor, CRM excellence, and MEDDICC-driven execution to deliver predictable outcomes

· Create demand at the top. Leverage deep CXO relationships to unlock net-new pipeline and sponsor enterprise-wide learning and publishing transformations

· Win big and expand fast. Deliver consistent net-new and expansion growth through value-led, outcome-based selling

· Lead from strategy to impact. Own the full sales lifecycle from territory design and discovery to close and post-sale value realization

· Out-position the market. Continuously sharpen competitive strategy and regional positioning to win complex, multi-country deals

· Verticalize to win. Build industry-specific playbooks and localized narratives aligned to JAPAC buying dynamics and compliance needs

· Scale through partners. Orchestrate joint GTM motions with global SIs, hyperscalers, and regional ecosystem leaders

· Drive customer value. Partner with Customer Success to ensure adoption, measurable outcomes, and sustained expansion

· Move faster with AI. Apply AI-driven insights to territory planning, content creation, and forecast accuracy

· Be the face of Adobe. Influence the market through executive briefings, keynotes, and thought leadership

· Lead with trust. Champion governance, ethical AI, and data responsibility across all engagements

What You Need to Succeed

· 10+ years in B2B software sales, including 5–10 years leading enterprise teams in JAPAC, with success in complex, multi-country deals.

· Strong Enterprise SaaS background and passion for learning-led digital transformation.

· Proven ability to influence C-suite executives, with personal ownership of senior relationships and pipeline generation.

· Expertise in consultative, value-based selling, with fluency in MEDDICC/Challenger and modern AI-enabled sales tools.

· Demonstrated success in partner-led GTM, working with global SIs, hyperscalers, and regional partners.

· Executive presence and communication excellence, including confident public speaking at industry and customer forums.

· Strong operational discipline across pipeline management, forecasting, and CRM hygiene.

· Commitment to inclusive leadership, coaching, and developing future-ready sales talent.

Why Join Us

· Help JAPAC’s most innovative enterprises unlock business impact with learning‑led transformation.

· Lead a strategic specialist team with global visibility and the ability to influence product and GTM direction.

The Opportunity

Adobe Experience Manager is the Enterprise CMS trusted by 70% of the world's top brands as the platform to drive their business.

At the heart of this experience is AEM Experience Hub - a unified, intelligent front door to the AEM ecosystem. Experience Hub provides a centralized starting point that brings together tools, environments, resources, and personalized workflows tailored to each user’s role, making it easier to navigate and execute work seamlessly. It is also where agentic workflows are initiated, embedding AI-powered assistance directly into content creation, optimization, and orchestration to accelerate delivery and drive smarter digital experiences at scale.

Candidates who enjoy solving sophisticated technical challenges, have a passion for delighting customers and who are self-motivated to push themselves in a team oriented culture, will thrive in our team. Join us!

What You'll Do

You and your team will focus on building the modern entry-point into the AEM systems, merging both traditional use-cases and agentic flows.

Work closely with other groups as well as product management to define and implement this platform as well as to integrate it with other services at Adobe.

Evaluate the current architecture, determine risks and opportunities, and come up with proposal for mitigation and improvements.

Use your outstanding technical skills to mentor junior members of the team.

Research various technologies and define architectural improvements. Build prototypes or core features.

Drive adoption of new technologies and contribute to continuous increase of technical knowledge across engineering teams.

What you need to succeed

You treat AI as a force-multiplier, you know when to trust an agent, when to stay in the loop, and how to build systems that remain safe and auditable.

AI coding assistants: daily active use of Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar as core engineering tools. Not just for autocomplete, but for full-feature development, code review, architecture exploration, and test generation

Multi-agent orchestration: experience decomposing work across agents, managing agent-to-agent communication, tool calling, and using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar

LLM API integration: Anthropic, OpenAI, or Gemini: streaming, function calling, structured outputs, and cost/latency management

Nice to have: evaluation and testing, designing evals, measuring agent accuracy, catching regressions in LLM-powered features

Technical skills:

Passionate about computer science & developing software

At least 5 years of practical experience developing products

Strong proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript and modern web development (ES6+, React or similar frameworks)

Proficiency in using AI tools for engineering tasks is considered a strong plus

Experience building high-performance web applications with focus on user experience

Experience in building and operating distributed and scalable web services (REST)

Comfortable with full-stack development (frontend, backend APIs, databases, integrations, CI/CD, monitoring)

Good understanding of OOP, design patterns and development principles and practices

Being adaptable to a multifaceted environment, loves to experiment and prototype

Very good problem solving skills, ability to deep-dive to find the root of the problem

Show initiative and have a self-managed approach

Excellent verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills

Good English language knowledge, both written and spoken

Bonus skills:

Experience with cloud services platforms such as AWS or Azure

Knowledge of Java technologies and frameworks (Spring, Spring Boot)

The opportunity

You have likely used something we built today, possibly more than once. Our distributed engineering team builds the next generation of Commerce capabilities for some of the biggest brands globally. In 2026, this involves systems where agents, models, and humans work together in the same loop. We deliver at a scale that was unattainable two years ago.

This isn't an AI-curious role. It's an AI-native one.

What you'll actually be doing

Own the integration between Adobe Commerce and LLM partners, the infrastructure that puts agentic shopping capabilities in front of millions of customers

Compose and build multi-agent workflows that decompose complex commerce problems: product discovery, personalization, checkout optimization, things that benefit from agents collaborating rather than a single monolithic service

Work across the stack on a high-performance, cloud-native e-commerce platform that's being actively reinvented

Build the architecture. We have hard problems and want engineers who want to get into them, not just complete tickets

Push back on how we've been doing things. If an agent can handle a chunk of work better, make the case and prove it

What you bring

You treat AI tools as your actual development environment, not a novelty. You know when to trust an agent to run with something and when to stay in the loop and you build systems with that distinction baked in.

Agentic development as a daily practice: Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or similar used for full-feature development, architecture exploration, test generation, code review.

You managed agent-to-agent communication, handled tool calling, and used frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or the Claude tool use API in a project that shipped or was validated

LLM API proficiency with Anthropic, OpenAI: streaming, function calling, structured outputs, and the judgment to manage cost/latency tradeoffs that matter at scale

Ideally you've built evals, measured agent accuracy over time, and caught regressions before users did. This is increasingly non-negotiable in production AI systems

Technical baseline

Frontend: React

Backend: Python or Node.js, production-grade

Strong fundamentals: OOP, functional programming, source control, software lifecycle

APIs: RESTful, GraphQL

You own what you ship: CI/CD, monitoring and alerting (Grafana, Prometheus), infrastructure as code

Commerce domain experience or equivalent experience is a genuine advantage here — there's a lot of context that takes time to build

The Project Graph team is looking for a Principal Product Manager to lead the vision, strategy, and execution of our Graph platform, a core, highly technical product used to design, visualize, execute, and share complex workflows through graph-based systems. Project Graph powers both an advanced node-based editor and downstream, simplified experiences built on top of those graphs.

This role sits at the intersection of UX, systems design, AI-enabled workflows, and platform thinking, and requires deep empathy for advanced users such as developers, technical artists, ML practitioners, and designers.

As a principal-level PM, you will define long-term direction, tackle ambiguous problems, and work closely with engineering, design, and leadership to scale a powerful, performant, and extensible graph authoring and execution platform.

What you’ll do

Define the long-term vision and roadmap for the Graph platform, including the editor, execution model, plugins, APIs, extensibility, and interoperability across products and surfaces.

Define what “great” looks like for graph-based authoring across beginner, advanced, and expert users, including transitions between power-user tooling and simplified downstream experiences.

Lead discovery efforts to deeply understand user workflows, pain points, and mental models in graph-based and automation-driven systems.

Translate complex user needs into clear product requirements, PRDs, and success metrics across both authoring and execution.

Collaborate with design to shape interaction patterns for node creation, connections, layouts, debugging, inspection, and working at scale.

Partner closely with engineering to break down large, ambiguous problems into shippable increments without losing architectural coherence.

Work with engineers on architecture-level decisions affecting performance, data models, rendering, and execution to ensure the system performs well with large graphs and real-world workloads.

Understand and influence systems such as graph execution models, state management, serialization, versioning, and reproducibility.

Define platform primitives that enable reuse, sharing, and distribution of graph-based workflows in different contexts.

Act as a bridge between user needs and technical realities, setting clear outcomes while avoiding prescriptive implementation decisions.

What you need to succeed

8–12+ years of product management experience, with significant ownership of complex, technical, or platform products.

Prior experience with node-based editors, visual programming tools, workflow builders, automation systems, or graph-based products, direct or adjacent.

Proven track record of shipping and iterating on sophisticated user interfaces used by expert or technical users.

Strong systems thinking with the ability to reason about interconnected components, constraints, and emergent behavior.

Deep empathy for power users and creators who rely on precision, speed, debuggability, and flexibility.

Comfort working closely with highly technical engineering teams on performance-critical, architecture-heavy systems.

Ability to operate independently at a principal level while influencing cross-functional partners.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, especially for complex and abstract concepts.

Bonus points

Background in developer tools, creative tools, game engines, VFX pipelines, ML tooling, data platforms, or automation systems.

Familiarity with graph concepts such as DAGs, execution graphs, dependency graphs, and scheduling.

Experience with extensible platforms, plugin systems, SDKs, or scripting environments.

Experience shipping products that combine authoring tools with runtime or execution environments.

Exposure to AI-driven workflows, generative systems, or model orchestration tools.

Job Description

Adobe Services Delivery is building deep and impactful partnerships with customers by investing our best thinking and resources to offer prescriptive, differentiated tools and thought leadership that help customers navigate and accelerate their digital trajectories.

Digital Strategists own the development and delivery of original, inspiring, and thought provoking workshops and strategic engagements that help customers chart their digital transformation journeys and feel confident taking the next steps—particularly in large scale, enterprise digital marketing environments leveraging Adobe Experience Cloud.

Workshop & Thought Leadership Development

Accountable for the development of workshops that foster cross functional partnerships and create practical roadmaps to help customers mature and transform their digital capabilities. Workshop materials include original assets designed to spark customer imagination and drive action on the vision established during the engagement. Deliverables may include POVs, strategy tools and methodologies, maturity models, and repeatable, hypothesis driven frameworks.

Expand existing repeatable, industry specific workshops into new industries, including associated data harvesting, analysis, collateral creation, and deliverable production.

Harvest insights from workshops to understand evolving customer needs and ensure offerings and prescriptive frameworks remain compelling, relevant, and up to date.

Author original thought leadership and compelling proposals on emerging or relevant digital themes to attract customers and drive new opportunities. Thought leadership may include proposals, frameworks, white papers, blogs, videos, and other media to support brand awareness, workshop adoption, and new business development.

Workshop & Thought Leadership Execution

Spearhead and own the delivery of high quality, consultative workshops with strong executive presence.

Engage C suite and senior executive audiences through compelling storytelling that drives action and organizational change.

Lead customers to strategic solutions that address complex business challenges using prescriptive methodologies, tools, frameworks, and high quality roadmaps.

Apply a cross discipline, entrepreneurial perspective, seamlessly adapting across topics and conversations to guide customers toward actionable outcomes.

Surface and drive new opportunities for Adobe Strategy and Readiness Services offerings.

Operations Management & Marketing

Track and monitor workshop and solution progress throughout the delivery lifecycle—from initial POVs to workshop execution, asset development, and final readouts.

Harvest and track insights and attributable operational outcomes to support reporting and growth.

Assist in the production of weekly customer impact newsletters.

Engage ecosystem stakeholders to promote workshops internally and externally, building a sustainable pipeline of customer participation.

What You Need to Succeed

Past experience in a consultative strategy role, leading or supporting large scale enterprise digital marketing transformations using Adobe Customer Experience Orchestration Cloud.

2+ years of experience delivering strategy and implementation services involving three or more of the following Adobe Experience Cloud solutions:

Adobe Analytics or Customer Journey Analytics

Adobe Journey Optimizer or Adobe Campaign

Adobe Real Time CDP or Audience Manager

Adobe Experience Manager (AEM)

Adobe Target

Adobe Experience Platform

GenStudio

Proven experience acting as a trusted advisor driving digital transformation initiatives.

Experience crafting digital or marketing strategies, with a strong understanding of the technologies and operating models required to activate them.

Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to engage both senior business leaders and technical stakeholders.

A forward thinking, self starting, entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to create organic demand.

Creative problem solver capable of translating complex, ambiguous challenges into clear, navigable frameworks.

Strong business acumen with the ability to articulate value drivers through storytelling and recognize conversational cues to deepen engagement.

Awareness of fundamental negotiation techniques and the ability to apply them effectively.

Comfort navigating rapidly changing meeting dynamics and shifting priorities.

Outstanding analytical and problem solving skills, including research, data analysis, hypothesis development, and synthesis of recommendations.

Ability to identify patterns within complex and unstructured data sets to surface meaningful insights and opportunities.

High intellectual curiosity and ability to quickly absorb and apply new concepts.

Strong organizational and self marketing skills.

Big 4 or management consulting background preferred, but not required.

Opportunity 

Security is foundational to Adobe’s product development and operational excellence. Our security practices are deeply embedded across our software lifecycle and are continuously refined through collaboration with global partners, leading researchers, and industry organizations. These efforts ensure Adobe remains at the forefront of threat detection, prevention, and incident response.

We are seeking a Senior Director of Security India to lead and expand Adobe’s global security engineering capabilities, with a strong focus on our India operations. This executive will play a critical role in shaping Adobe’s security strategy, driving innovation, and building trust with our customers by ensuring their data is protected and privacy is preserved.

Role Summary 

As a Senior Director, you will be responsible for the strategic leadership and operational excellence of Adobe’s Security organization in India. You will collaborate closely with the CSO, global engineering leaders, and cross-functional partners to shape and drive enterprise-wide security initiatives, in addition to engaging externally with CTO/CIO/CISOs of our APAC customers. This role requires a visionary leader with deep technical expertise, strong people leadership, and a proven track record of influencing at the executive level.

What You’ll Do 

Strategic Leadership: Define and implement the long-term vision for Adobe’s security engineering function in India, aligned with global security priorities.

Site Presence: Continue to build the security brand and presence in India with leaders across Adobe.

Customer-Facing: Engage with CTO/CIO/CISOs of our APAC customer to help build trust in our products, build relationships and help answer their security related questions, and in case of a security incident, quickly come up to speed to lead customer confidence calls.

Global Collaboration: Partner with the CSO and senior leaders across engineering, legal, and cloud infrastructure to drive cohesive security strategies.

Operational Excellence: Oversee delivery of high-impact security services, ensuring operational efficiency, scalability, and continuous improvement.

Innovation & Engineering: Lead teams in developing innovative solutions for application security, cloud security, and cyber defense.

Risk Management: Champion enterprise risk mitigation strategies, including threat modeling, vulnerability management, and incident response.

Talent Development: Build and mentor a high-performing team of security engineers, researchers, and ethical hackers. Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, and inclusion.

Stakeholder Engagement: Establish trust and influence with senior executives, internal partners, and external vendors to advance Adobe’s security posture.

Compliance & Governance: Ensure adherence to global security standards, regulatory requirements, and internal policies.

Thought Leadership: Represent Adobe in industry forums, contribute to security research, and drive awareness of emerging threats and standard processes.

Complexity: Navigate a highly matrixed organization, building on strong partnerships across regions to shape security strategy, execution, and long-term Adobe success and reputation.

What You Need to Succeed 

B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Security Engineering, or related field.

15+ years of progressive experience in security engineering, including 10+ years in leadership roles with global scope.

Proven success leading large-scale security programs across cloud, application, and enterprise environments.

Deep expertise in cybersecurity frameworks, threat intelligence, and secure software development practices.

Strong understanding of infrastructure as code, security automation, and compliance as code.

Experience managing cross-functional teams, building strong partnerships across regions, influencing senior partners, and building customer relationships.

Recognized as an influential, innovative, and collaborative leader in the industry.

Certifications such as CISM, CISA, or CISSP are a plus.

Exceptional communication, critical thinking, and executive presence, both internally and externally.

Demonstrated commitment to inclusive practices.

Own and evolve a portfolio-level intelligence framework that measures content value, utilization, and performance across multiple businesses, informing planning and investment.

Assess content supply health across depth, fragmentation, contributor and geographic diversity, metadata, and coverage to drive sourcing priorities and readiness for emerging customer needs.

Identify and prioritize strategic content gaps by analyzing search behavior, market signals, enterprise requirements, and generative prompt patterns, shaping acquisition and production roadmaps.

Lead advanced analytics initiatives to optimize supply-side economics, including ranking efficacy, contributor yield, marketplace liquidity, and monetization pathways.

Develop predictive and forecasting models that anticipate shifts in demand, creative trends, AI training requirements, and revenue contribution, guiding multi-year content strategies.

Lead all aspects of building visualization dashboards, important metrics, and reporting frameworks that surface sourcing efficiency, contributor performance, and content economic value.

Partner cross-functionally across product, engineering, content, finance, and enterprise teams to operationalize insights, evolve business models, and accelerate real-time predictive decisions.

Lead, develop, and mentor a hard-working analytics team, strengthening talent capabilities, driving analytical rigor, and maturing organizational intelligence practices at scale.

What You Need to Succeed

10+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, Analytics, or Data Science within digital media, marketplaces, or eCommerce environments.

Strong analytical and statistical skills with the ability to structure ambiguous business problems into measurable frameworks.

Proficiency in SQL (or Hive), Python or R, ETL development, and cloud-based data platforms (e.g., Databricks).

Proven experience building and operationalizing predictive models, forecasting systems, and segmentation frameworks.

Experience with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., Databricks) and advanced statistical modeling, and designing executive-ready dashboards using Tableau or equivalent.

Demonstrated ability to influence senior leadership through clear data storytelling and strategic recommendations.

Experience leading data-informed transformation and multi-year, cross-business initiatives using emerging AI/ML capabilities.

The Opportunity
The Adobe Security Engineering Partnerships (SEP) team is seeking a Senior Product Security Engineer to scale security capabilities across our software Supply Chain, Kubernetes deployment environments, and cloud-native systems.
We're looking for a candidate that is passionate about securing the software
development lifecycle (SDLC), strengthening software supply chain integrity, and
embedding security into modern delivery pipelines using automation-first, secure-by-default approaches. You will operate as a security expert, influencing engineering organizations and key stakeholders, designing scalable security solutions, and independently managing risk across complex, cloud-native systems.

What you'll Do 

Develop and implement security controls across CI/CD platforms including GitHub workflows, Jenkins, and internal build systems.

Establish secure-by-default pipeline standards covering build isolation, artifact integrity, secrets management, and least-privilege access.

Identify systemic supply chain risks and build scalable mitigations that prevent entire classes of vulnerabilities.

Secure Kubernetes-based platforms across multi-cloud environments.

Define security baselines for clusters, workloads, container runtimes, admission controls, and network segmentation.

Perform security architecture reviews for complex CI/CD, cloud, and Kubernetes environments.

Independently manage security risk by making defensible, risk-based decisions balancing business velocity and security posture.

Recognize capability gaps and design new security solutions that increase coverage and effectiveness across multiple product areas.

Serve as a trusted security advisor and technical lead within your domain.

Establish yourself as a domain expert in CI/CD, supply chain, and cloud security.

What you need to succeed 

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field of study.

6+ years of experience in Product Security, Application Security, Cloud Security, or a related field.

Experience threat modeling for CI/CD and cloud-native systems.

Deep expertise in CI/CD systems such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or similar platforms.

Strong experience securing Kubernetes and containerized workloads in cloud-native environments.

Hands-on knowledge of software supply chain security, artifact signing, and open-source risk management.

Experience implementing GitOps workflows and securing infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation, etc.).

Strong programming or scripting ability (e.g., Python, Go, Bash) with experience building automation and security tooling.

Demonstrated ability to identify systemic risks and design scalable, automation-first mitigations.

Strong understanding of Secure SDLC practices and how security solutions reduce risk across large organizations.

Proven ability to influence engineering teams and serve as a technical leader without formal management authority.

Strategic Program Manager leading complex, cross-functional programs that directly support business objectives and long-term organizational goals of the Adobe Customer Experience Orchestration organization. Responsible for structuring and managing multiple programs simultaneously, ensuring initiatives are coordinated, aligned, and delivering measurable impact across the enterprise.

Self-starting critical thinker who combines strategic clarity with operational rigor, proactively identifying risks, driving alignment, and ensuring accountability across diverse teams and interested parties. What you'll Do

Design, structure, and manage 2–4 programs at a time.

Translate high-level goals into coordinated program roadmaps, governance models, and measurable outcomes within the Objectives/Key Results (“OKR”) framework.

Build and maintain a program life cycle based on tangible progress points and deliverables that act as health indicators and allow you to “look around the corner” and identify risks and dependencies on or over the horizon.

Drive relentless accountability and prioritization by aligning all program activities to defined picture of success, assigning clear ownership and accountability, and subsequently leading and supporting all participants and owners to deliver expected results.

Confident, articulate, cross-functional collaborator with the ability to prioritize and multi-task in a fast-paced environment to deliver customer-centric results.

Dedicated team member that is casual in tone but serious about impact. Conversations are human. Humor is welcome. Hierarchy does not dominate the room. People can speak plainly and be themselves.

8+ years of experience in program or portfolio management, preferably in complex, cross-functional environments.

Ability to land in a fluid environment and immediately collaborate with SMEs to establish high- to mid-level delivery targets, and build or reshape the roadmap to balance expectations and reality.

Track record of mentoring senior engineers and shaping engineering culture.

Experience building front ends for data-heavy, workflow-driven, or AI-powered products.

The Opportunity

As a Value Engineer within the JAPAC Ultimate Success team, you will partner closely with Value Advisors and Account Teams to build rigorous, defensible financial models that quantify the measurable business impact of Adobe’s solutions.

Your mandate is to ensure that every value claim — from revenue uplift to retention improvement and operational efficiency — is supported by structured assumptions, credible benchmarks, and CFO-ready modelling. You will operate at the intersection of finance, analytics, and strategy, translating complex product capabilities and customer data into clear economic impact models that withstand executive scrutiny.

This role is less about leading the room and more about ensuring that when we enter it, our numbers are airtight.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Modelling & Quantification

Build robust return on investment, NPV, payback, and scenario-based financial models to quantify revenue growth, retention impact, cost efficiencies, and productivity gains.

Conduct sensitivity analysis and assumption testing to ensure models remain defensible under CFO-level scrutiny.

Structure value levers clearly and prevent double-counting across impact areas.

Translate marketing, commerce, and experience metrics into financial outcomes (margin impact, lifetime value, cost avoidance).

Develop scalable modelling templates and tools to standardise value calculations across the region.

Value Workshops and Business Case Development

Partner with Value Advisors and Account Teams to convert strategic value hypotheses into quantified economic impact to support Value Workshops and Business case development.

Document assumptions transparently and apply conservative modelling principles to maintain credibility.

Reconcile customer-supplied data with benchmarks and Adobe telemetry to ensure integrity of outputs.

Support renewals and expansion cases with defensible financial analysis.

Prepare executive-ready financial summaries that simplify complex modelling into clear decision-support outputs. 

Be able to explain, communicate and answer questions on the business case or models to customer executives.

Value Realisation Analytics

Track realised versus projected value across use cases, adoption, and Net Dollar Retention (N$R).

Analyse performance data to identify value at risk, underperformance drivers, and incremental growth opportunities.

Support quarterly business reviews with updated financial insights and scenario updates.

Maintain structured measurement frameworks to ensure consistent value tracking across strategic accounts.

Benchmarking & Methodology

Understand and leverage existing Adobe tools to support Value modelling,

Maintain and refine regional industry benchmarks and modelling assumptions.

Incorporate new Adobe product capabilities into financial impact models.

Contribute to the evolution of JAPAC value modelling frameworks, templates, and playbooks.

Support automation and AI-enabled modelling to scale analytical output while maintaining rigor.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Collaborate closely with Value Advisors, Sales, Ultimate Success teams, and Professional Services to ensure alignment between strategy and quantification.

Act as the quantitative authority during value workshops, renewal planning and expansion conversations.

Provide internal coaching on modelling rigor and financial logic.

Help embed value thinking into lifecycle planning and expansion strategies.

What you bring:

5–10+ years of experience in FP&A, Commercial Finance, Deals Advisory, Valuations, Strategy Consulting, Corporate Development, or Value Engineering.

Advanced financial modelling capability (expert Excel skills required; experience with scenario modelling and sensitivity analysis essential).

Strong understanding of SaaS economics, marketing return on investment, retention modelling, and unit economics.

Proven experience building defensible arguments for enterprise technology or digital transformation programs.

High analytical rigor and comfort challenging assumptions.

Ability to translate complex financial analysis into crisp, executive-ready outputs.

Experience supporting executive-level discussions (not necessarily leading them).

Familiarity with Adobe Experience Cloud (Customer Experience Orchestration) or similar Martech ecosystems preferred.

Proficiency in Microsoft Suite (especially advanced Excel).

Ensure sales data is accurate

Work with Adobe Partners to drive new initiatives and deal execution within the Middle East 

Identify opportunities for sales optimisation 

Driving Customer Success

Build long-term client advocacy by highlighting the project successes to date and uncovering areas for further success to showcase Adobe’s ongoing value to their business. 

Act as the conduit between clients and the wider Adobe ecosystem, ensuring value is created at every stage of the process

Skills & Qualities 

Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results under tight deadlines.

Experience

The Art of Sales is changing:

The concept of selling has been around for decades, but businesses are digital now. The way sales are conducted must modernize too.

In most companies, sales teams are somewhere on the journey below:

(1) Sales scratch out their own leads by prospecting their networks, sending one-off or batch emails.

(2) Marketing turns over long lists of leads, which typically contacts in your target audience

On the other hand, we at Adobe – ICX sales are a Modern Sales Team of 400+ Digital sellers, supported by analytics and data science teams. We are integrated with Adobe.com digital marketing & engagement funnel and are developing capabilities on picking cues from the customers demographic (who) & behavioral (what) data that they leave on their journey with our business to predict next ‘sales action’ that will lead to revenue conversions (Future state).

The Challenge: 

We are building a team of Account Managers who will work with a focused cohort of the reseller transacted book of business.

This role is crucial in driving revenue growth through strategic cross-sell and upsell initiatives. 

The incumbent would be responsible for helping the customers adopt the solution with ease, optimizing their product experience and guiding them to internal support teams if need be.

This role entails the entire gambit of account management like Strategic Account planning, Client Need assessment, building connect strategies with multiple stakeholders, conducting extensive account reviews, driving growth through cross selling / upselling and building long term relationships. KPIs for this role will be maximizing Net ARR by growing Gross and mitigating Cancels.

What you’ll do as an Account Manager

Plays a critical role in developing and managing relationships with large customers from ICX book of business.

Build and nurture strong relationships with managers and decision-makers in these large accounts. Expand business relationships beyond IT and Procurement into the C-Suite. You will need to map target org at departmental level to succeed in this role.

Drive revenue growth by identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities. You would be responsible for driving Net ARR from the allocated customers for the various Creativity & Productivity solutions.

Account manager’s primary goal will be to understand Customer’s business needs / pain points on document workflows & creative content creation, offer solutions, and foster long-term partnerships that drive business growth.

Identify growth opportunities and revenue potential within the accounts.

Research customer contracts and purchasing history in Adobe's various customer management systems & external sources such as LinkedIn, ZoomInfo, etc. to figure out the expansion opportunity in an account.

Devise customized connect strategy based on the account plan.

Identify the segments that have a high propensity for Adobe’s solutions and then plan customer outreach and meetings.

Sell into multiple levels of an organization, performing outbound prospecting to existing customers to identify new business relationships.

Engage customers daily via Teams / Video calls to conducting extensive account reviews.

During the account review understand clients' strategic goals, challenges, and pain points, and propose tailored solutions to address them. Develop and execute strategic account plans that align with clients' business objectives.

Lead negotiations and pricing discussions to achieve mutually beneficial outcomes.

You will serve as a trusted advisor ensuring the successful deployment of products.

Address any issues or concerns promptly to maintain positive client relationships.

Stay informed about industry trends, regulatory changes, and the competitive landscape of Document / Creative domain. Provide clients with valuable insights and thought leadership on industry best practices.

Collaborate with Solution Specialists to maximize footprint of growing Adobe Solution streams like Adobe Acrobat & Sign, Creative Cloud, Substance, Stock etc.

Managing the opportunity pipeline from week to week, providing accurate and timely updates to management on progress and outlook.

Act as the voice of the client within the organization, representing their interests and needs.

What you need to succeed

MM/SMB Segment exposure and proven ability to manage a large customer set.

4 + Years’ experience in a similar role, with experience in selling SAAS solutions preferred.

Proven track record leading a matrixed organization to sell SAAS solutions and the ability to expand influence to multiple stakeholders in the customer environment

Ability to forge and maintain strong business relationships from IT to the C-Suite.

Excellent communication and presentation skills and capable of presenting with any person, at any level within a customer.

Proven experience of using quantitative and qualitative analysis to identify new sales opportunities.

Should have skills that clearly demonstrate the ability to manage accounts and sell solutions.

Flair for technology and ability to lead a customer conversation with value-selling rather than product features pitch.

Ability to independently give basic product demos to customers.

EMEA Sales Experience preferably.

Bachelor’s Degree or Equivalent

The challenge

At Adobe, we are on a mission to deliver world-class products that empower creativity. We are looking for dedicated individuals familiar with After Effects. They enjoy finding software bugs (a.k.a breaking things), and want to ship the highest quality products. This role offers an outstanding opportunity to work with the latest digital video and animation technology. Quality Engineers are passionate about testing features, writing clear and concise bug reports, crafting test cases, verifying bug fixes, communicating effectively with developers, other quality engineers, and customers. As a Quality Engineer, you will collaborate with a dedicated team to strictly uphold our high standards, ensuring our products meet and exceed user expectations.

What you'll do

Advocate for customers and recommend features and fixes that improve their workflow.

Work with customers to better understand user workflows and reproduce their bugs.

Write clear documentation for projects and features for which you are responsible.

Implement test cases, ad hoc testing, and performance testing on new and existing features.

Perform interoperability testing between After Effects and other Adobe applications.

Collaborate with development and user experience team members to build test cases for new features.

Identify and use existing tools and test materials from other Adobe QE teams.

Isolate bugs, write detailed bug reports, and verify and regress bugs.

What you need to succeed

5+yrs experience using Adobe After Effects (familiarity with other animation, video editing, and digital audio programs is an advantage).

Experience using ExtendScript/JavaScript/typescript to build scripts.

Proven track record in testing commercially released applications.

Must meet deadlines and demonstrate outstanding attention to detail.

Strong organization skills are critical.

Strong problem-solving skills.

Solid understanding of Agile development processes and scrum.

Familiarity with Windows and Mac platforms.

Strong ability to communicate clearly and effectively in both verbal and written forms.

Ability to work independently and in a collaborative team environment.

A college degree in film or a related area is advantageous.

The Opportunity

Adobe is looking for a high-energy, driven, and self-motivated individual to join Adobe's Customer Experience Orchestration team as an Associate Business Development Representative supporting our Business Development, Marketing and Sales teams.

This is a net new early in career business development role, and as such, you will be given the opportunity to learn, grow and be successful in understanding the Adobe solutions for the Customer Experience Orchestration business.

In this role, you will be our first line of contact with prospects. You will excel in establishing meaningful conversations with a variety of IT and C-level decision makers in a variety of industries, and you will prospect, educate, qualify, and develop target accounts to generate sales-ready meetings and opportunities.
 

Through account-based sales development, you will identify and build sales pipeline that leads to revenue growth. As a starter role in Adobe, you will have the opportunity to work across a number of different industries, business personas and teams. This role is ideal for a highly motivated early-in-career professional who is resilient and keen to learn new skills in building and executing business development prospecting.

Measurement

As a SDR, you will be asked to sit in differing Business Development roles. Your day to day activities will be at times across differing segments within the organisation. In the future, as your success continues, you will be moved to a dedicated account patch, once your area of specialisation is uncovered and developed. The compensation is 70:30, with ramp sales targets initially.

What You’ll Do:

Generate sales pipeline through inbound/outbound prospecting activities via telephone, video, and email

Build awareness into the account base through regular email campaigns, drive attendance to live and online webinars and assist with event/webinar follow ups.

Research accounts, identify key players, generate interest and develop accounts to uncover and develop opportunities for Adobe’s products.

Handle and overcome prospect objections with confidence.

Become a trusted resource and develop positive relationships with your sales ecosystem and peers.

Update CRM, Outreach, and other tools as necessary to ensure the capture of key activity history & ensure a smooth hand-off to the Account Executive as necessary.

Maintain up-to-date knowledge of Adobe's competitive positioning in the marketplace.

Meet and exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual pipeline generating targets to ensure territory revenue objectives and pipeline linearity.

What You Will Need to Succeed

1–3 years of relevant experience.

A track record of achieving measurable sales goals, in IT, or any other sales-focused environment.

Attention to detail to support accurate entry and management of lead data in a CRM system as required.

Positive and energetic phone skills, excellent listening skills, strong writing and presentation skills

An interest in sales prospecting tactics and technologies.

An interest in marketing technologies.

An interest in developing and learning new skills.

Motivated by individual and team achievement.

Highly organised with the ability to work in fast-paced environment.

Resilience.

The Opportunity

Adobe is looking for a high-energy, driven, and self-motivated individual to join Adobe's sales development team as a Business Development Representative (BDR) supporting our sales teams in the Americas Digital Media or Digital Experience organization. 

 

As a BDR, you are the first line of contact with prospects and must excel in establishing meaningful conversations with a variety of IT and C-level decision makers in commerical or public sector. You will prospect, educate, qualify, and develop target accounts to generate sales-ready meetings and opportunities. Through account-based sales development, you will identify and build sales pipeline that leads to revenue growth. What You’ll Do 

Generate sales pipeline through outbound prospecting activities via telephone, video, and email 

Meet and exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual pipeline generating targets to ensure territory revenue objectives and pipeline linearity 

Build awareness into the account base through regular email campaigns and drive attendance to live and online webinars 

Research accounts, identify key players, generate interest and develop accounts to uncover and develop opportunities for Adobe’s products

Handle and overcome prospect objections with confidence 

Become a trusted resource and develop positive relationships with your sales ecosystem 

Maintain up-to-date knowledge of Adobe's competitive positioning in the marketplace 

 

What you need to succeed 

Proven track record of achieving measurable inside sales goals in a sales environment where accurate entry and management of lead data in a CRM system was required 

Prior experience cold calling and generating new leads

Positive and energetic phone skills, excellent listening skills, strong writing and presentation skills 

Proficient with sales prospecting tactics and technologies 

Motivated by individual and team achievement

Highly organized with ability to work in fast-paced environment

Demonstrate adaptability and flexibility as part of an ever-growing sales organization 

4-year college degree or equivalent experience required

The Opportunity

The Adobe Customer Solutions Engagement Manager leads substantial, innovative engagements for critical Adobe accounts. Acting as a trusted advisor and strategic guide, you help Sales and Delivery teams align projects with customers’ objectives. Recognized as a business contributor and delivery specialist, you are the primary customer contact in a billable capacity. You drive the delivery of desired results while preserving strong executive connections.

This position merges excellent delivery and client relationship supervision, concentrating on client and partner communication, cross-functional teamwork, and technical skills to advance business transformation. Success requires collaborating across people, process, and technology with an industry or customer practitioner perspective to produce measurable customer value.

What You'll Do

Customer Engagement & Delivery Leadership

The role manages the success of a defined set of strategic Services customers in the region. It ensures customer requirements are met and that engagements deliver measurable business value aligned to customer priorities. It acts as the primary contact for customer executives and coordinates with partners across the customer’s broader ecosystem. After contract booking, it ensures a smooth and efficient transition from Sales to Delivery. It works closely with Sales, Delivery, and Product teams to align on customer success plans and find opportunities to drive value across Adobe solutions. It serves as the main point of contact at senior management level, resolving customer issues quickly and keeping engagements on track.

Operational Excellence

You are responsible for driving accurate and effective revenue management, including growth and margin execution, revenue acceleration, backlog burn, contract expiration and extension management, and close alignment with Adobe Finance and Operations.

You manage the Services team by coordinating team staffing, onboarding, and transitions within the assigned account(s).

Services Expansion & Opportunity Development

You will partner closely with Adobe Sales to build new services opportunities and support contract extensions, change requests, and addendum. You contribute strategic feedback to account planning in collaboration with the wider account teams, and lead efforts to renew and expand Customer Solutions relationships with existing clients by demonstrating a deep understanding of customer objectives and the scope, activities, and resources required to achieve them.

What you'll need to succeed

8+ years of hands-on experience in professional services, consulting or customer delivery experience of large programs, preferably in SaaS or enterprise software.

Experience with enterprise level project or program management.

Proven track record of building positive relationships, managing complex customer engagements and leading transformation.

Passion for operational rigor and customer value, with a proven ability to collaborate, lead and influence in a matrixed organization.

Strong business insight and industry expertise with ability to speak to value drivers and use cases in customer's context via experience-based story telling.

Ability to effectively navigate complex client situations and act as a change agent for our clients and within Adobe Services.

Strong written and verbal communication skills in both Danish and English, executive level presence and experience in working in a client advisory role.

Able to travel to support client engagements.

Bachelor’s degree, with an MBA or equivalent experience preferred.

Digital marketing experience is preferred.
